International Coders.Title: Task Distribution and Management
International Coders.Description: Develop a system to distribute tasks to international coders, allowing them to start and end tasks, track time spent, and report progress. This system will ensure efficient task allocation and management.

User Stories.Title: Task Assignment
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to receive assigned tasks so that I know what work I need to complete.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tasks are assigned to coders based on their availability and skill set.
Coders receive notifications when new tasks are assigned.
Tasks include detailed descriptions and deadlines.

User Stories.Title: Start Task
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to start a task so that I can begin tracking the time spent on it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can mark a task as 'Started' to begin time tracking.
The system records the start time of the task.
Coders receive a confirmation that the task has started.

User Stories.Title: End Task
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to end a task so that I can stop tracking the time spent on it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can mark a task as 'Completed' to stop time tracking.
The system records the end time of the task.
Coders receive a confirmation that the task has ended.

User Stories.Title: Track Time Spent
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to track the time spent on each task so that I can provide accurate reports.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system automatically tracks the time from when a task is started to when it is ended.
Coders can view the total time spent on each task.
Time tracking data is stored and accessible for reporting.

User Stories.Title: Report Progress
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to report my progress on tasks so that project managers can stay updated.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can add progress notes to each task.
Progress reports include the percentage of completion and any blockers.
Project managers receive notifications of progress updates.

User Stories.Title: View Assigned Tasks
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to view all my assigned tasks so that I can manage my workload effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can see a list of all their assigned tasks.
Tasks are displayed with their status (e.g., Not Started, In Progress, Completed).
Tasks include relevant details such as descriptions, deadlines, and priority levels.

User Stories.Title: Update Task Status
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to update the status of my tasks so that the project manager knows the current state of each task.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can change the status of a task (e.g., In Progress, Blocked, Completed).
Status updates are logged with timestamps.
Project managers receive notifications of status changes.

User Stories.Title: Receive Task Notifications
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to receive notifications about task updates so that I am always informed about changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders receive notifications for new task assignments, status changes, and deadlines.
Notifications can be received via email or within the system.
Coders can configure their notification preferences.

User Stories.Title: Access Task History
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to access the history of my tasks so that I can review my past work and time spent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can view a history of all tasks they have worked on.
Task history includes start and end times, progress notes, and status changes.
Task history is searchable and filterable by date and project.

User Stories.Title: Submit Task Feedback
User Stories.Description: As an international coder, I want to submit feedback on tasks so that I can communicate any issues or suggestions for improvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can submit feedback on each task upon completion.
Feedback can include comments on task clarity, difficulty, and any encountered issues.
Project managers can review and respond to coder feedback.

International Coders.Title: Time Tracking and Reporting
International Coders.Description: Implement a feature to track the time spent on each task by coders. This will compile time data by contract and coder, providing detailed reports for invoicing and project management.

User Stories.Title: Task Assignment Interface
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to receive task assignments through a clear interface so that I can easily understand and start my tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can view a list of assigned tasks with details such as task name, description, and deadline.
Coders can acknowledge receipt of the task.
The interface is intuitive and easy to navigate.

User Stories.Title: Start Task Timer
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to start a timer when I begin a task so that my time spent on the task is accurately tracked.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can start a timer for a specific task.
The timer accurately records the start time.
The timer is linked to the specific task and contract.

User Stories.Title: Pause and Resume Task Timer
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to pause and resume the task timer so that breaks and interruptions are accounted for.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can pause the timer at any point during the task.
Coders can resume the timer from where it was paused.
The system accurately records the total time spent on the task, excluding paused time.

User Stories.Title: End Task Timer
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to end the timer when I finish a task so that the total time spent is recorded.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can end the timer for a specific task.
The system records the end time and calculates the total time spent on the task.
The total time is linked to the specific task and contract.

User Stories.Title: View Task Time Log
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to view a log of the time I have spent on each task so that I can review my work hours.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can view a detailed log of time spent on each task.
The log includes start time, end time, and total time spent.
The log is filterable by date, task, and contract.

User Stories.Title: Submit Task Time for Approval
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to submit my recorded task time for approval so that it can be reviewed and used for invoicing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can submit their recorded time for each task to their project manager.
The system notifies the project manager of the submitted time for approval.
Coders receive confirmation once their time has been approved.

User Stories.Title: Generate Time Report
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to generate a report of my time spent on tasks so that I can provide it for invoicing and project management.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can generate a time report for a specified period.
The report includes details such as task name, contract, start time, end time, and total time spent.
The report is exportable in PDF format.

User Stories.Title: Notification for Task Updates
User Stories.Description: As a coder, I want to receive notifications for task updates so that I am aware of any changes or new assignments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders receive notifications for new task assignments.
Coders receive notifications for updates or changes to existing tasks.
Notifications are delivered via email and the task management interface.

International Coders.Title: Project Kick-Off System
International Coders.Description: Create a project kick-off system that takes detailed plans and distributes tasks to coders. This system will also track the start and end times of tasks, ensuring accurate time tracking and project progress monitoring.

User Stories.Title: Task Distribution
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to receive tasks assigned to me from the project kick-off system so that I know what work I need to complete.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tasks are automatically assigned to coders based on the detailed project plan.
Coders receive notifications when new tasks are assigned.
Tasks include all necessary details such as description, deadline, and any relevant files or links.

User Stories.Title: Start Task
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to be able to start a task so that my work time can be tracked accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can mark tasks as 'In Progress' to indicate they have started working on them.
The system records the start time when a task is marked as 'In Progress'.
Coders receive a confirmation that the task has been started.

User Stories.Title: End Task
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to be able to end a task so that my work time can be tracked accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can mark tasks as 'Completed' to indicate they have finished working on them.
The system records the end time when a task is marked as 'Completed'.
Coders receive a confirmation that the task has been completed.

User Stories.Title: View Assigned Tasks
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to view all tasks assigned to me so that I can manage my workload effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can see a list of all tasks assigned to them.
The list includes task details such as description, status, start time, and end time.
Tasks are sortable by priority, deadline, and status.

User Stories.Title: Track Time Spent on Tasks
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want the system to track the time I spend on each task so that accurate records are kept for invoicing and project progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system automatically tracks the start and end times of tasks.
Coders can view the total time spent on each task.
Time tracking data is stored and linked to the relevant contract and coder.

User Stories.Title: Update Task Status
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to update the status of my tasks so that project managers can see my progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can update the status of tasks to 'Not Started', 'In Progress', or 'Completed'.
The system reflects the updated status in real-time.
Project managers receive notifications of status updates.

User Stories.Title: Receive Task Notifications
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to receive notifications for new tasks and status changes so that I am always informed about my work.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders receive notifications when new tasks are assigned.
Coders receive notifications when task statuses are updated.
Notifications include relevant details such as task description and deadlines.

User Stories.Title: Access Task Details
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to access detailed information about my tasks so that I have all the information I need to complete them.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can click on a task to view detailed information.
Task details include description, requirements, deadlines, and any attached files or links.
Coders can leave comments or ask questions about the task.

User Stories.Title: Submit Work for Review
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to submit my completed work for review so that project managers can verify it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can mark tasks as 'Submitted for Review' once completed.
The system notifies project managers when work is submitted for review.
Coders receive feedback or approval notifications from project managers.

User Stories.Title: View Feedback on Tasks
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to view feedback on my tasks so that I can make any necessary improvements.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders receive notifications when feedback is provided on their tasks.
Feedback is linked to the relevant task and includes comments and suggestions.
Coders can respond to feedback or request further clarification.

International Coders.Title: Code Analysis and Reporting
International Coders.Description: Develop the Myte Code Checker tool to analyze code changes daily, compare them with the previous day's data, and generate natural language reports. This will help coders understand the changes and updates in the codebase.

User Stories.Title: Daily Code Analysis
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want the Myte Code Checker to analyze the code changes daily so that I can understand the updates and modifications made to the codebase.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should automatically analyze the codebase at a specified time each day.
The analysis should include all changes made in the last 24 hours.
The tool should handle large codebases efficiently without significant performance degradation.

User Stories.Title: Comparison with Previous Day's Data
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want the Myte Code Checker to compare the current day's code with the previous day's data so that I can see what has changed.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should retrieve the previous day's codebase for comparison.
The comparison should highlight additions, deletions, and modifications in the code.
The tool should provide a clear and concise summary of the differences.

User Stories.Title: Natural Language Report Generation
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want the Myte Code Checker to generate a natural language report of the code changes so that I can easily understand the updates without delving into the code.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should use OpenAI Transformers to convert code changes into a natural language report.
The report should be clear, concise, and easy to understand.
The report should include a summary of key changes, affected files, and potential impacts.

User Stories.Title: Automated Report Delivery
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want the Myte Code Checker to automatically send the generated report to the relevant stakeholders so that everyone is informed about the code changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should send the report via email to a predefined list of stakeholders.
The report should be sent at a specified time each day.
The email should include the report as an attachment and a brief summary in the email body.

User Stories.Title: Customizable Analysis Parameters
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to customize the parameters for code analysis so that I can focus on specific areas of interest.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should allow users to specify which parts of the codebase to analyze.
Users should be able to set filters for specific file types, directories, or code sections.
The tool should save and apply these settings for future analyses.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling and Notifications
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want the Myte Code Checker to handle errors gracefully and notify me of any issues so that I can address them promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should log any errors encountered during the analysis process.
Users should receive notifications of errors via email or a dashboard alert.
The tool should provide detailed error messages to help diagnose and fix issues.

User Stories.Title: Historical Data Access
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want access to historical analysis reports so that I can review past changes and trends in the codebase.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should store all generated reports in a searchable database.
Users should be able to access and download past reports from a web interface.
The tool should provide filtering options to find specific reports based on date, project, or keywords.

International Coders.Title: Communication and Collaboration Tools
International Coders.Description: Implement tools for coders to communicate and collaborate effectively within the platform. This includes messaging, file sharing, and discussion boards to facilitate teamwork and coordination.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Messaging
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to send and receive real-time messages within the platform so that I can communicate instantly with my team members.
AcceptanceCriteria: Messages are delivered instantly to the recipient.
Users can see when a message has been read.
Users can send and receive messages in individual and group chats.
Messages are stored and can be searched later.

User Stories.Title: File Sharing
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to share files within the platform so that I can easily collaborate on documents and code with my team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can upload and download files within the chat.
Files are stored securely and can be accessed later.
Users can preview files within the platform before downloading.
File size limits and types are clearly defined and enforced.

User Stories.Title: Discussion Boards
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to participate in discussion boards within the platform so that I can collaborate on ideas and solutions with my team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can create new discussion threads.
Users can reply to existing threads.
Threads and replies are searchable.
Users can tag other users in discussions.

User Stories.Title: Task Assignment Notifications
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to receive notifications when tasks are assigned to me so that I am aware of my responsibilities and deadlines.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users receive instant notifications for new task assignments.
Notifications include task details and deadlines.
Users can mark notifications as read or unread.
Notifications are stored and can be reviewed later.

User Stories.Title: Project Updates
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to receive updates on project progress within the platform so that I am informed about the overall status and any changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users receive notifications for project milestones and updates.
Updates include relevant details and any action required.
Users can view a history of project updates.
Updates are linked to the relevant project and tasks.

User Stories.Title: Code Review Requests
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to request code reviews from my team members within the platform so that I can get feedback and improve my code quality.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can send code review requests to specific team members.
Review requests include the relevant code and context.
Reviewers can provide feedback directly within the platform.
Users receive notifications when a review is completed.

User Stories.Title: Shared Calendar
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want access to a shared calendar within the platform so that I can keep track of important dates and deadlines.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can view and add events to the shared calendar.
Events can be linked to specific projects and tasks.
Users receive notifications for upcoming events and deadlines.
Calendar is synchronized across all users and devices.

User Stories.Title: User Mentions
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to mention other users in messages and discussions so that I can draw their attention to specific content.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can mention other users using the '@' symbol.
Mentioned users receive notifications.
Mentions are linked to the relevant message or discussion.
Users can view all mentions of themselves in one place.

User Stories.Title: Activity Logs
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to view activity logs within the platform so that I can track changes and actions taken by team members.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can view a log of all activities within the platform.
Logs include details such as user, action, and timestamp.
Users can filter logs by date, user, and type of action.
Logs are stored securely and can be accessed later.

User Stories.Title: Private Messaging
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to send private messages to specific team members so that I can have confidential conversations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can send private messages to individual team members.
Private messages are visible only to the sender and recipient.
Users receive notifications for new private messages.
Private messages are stored securely and can be searched later.

International Coders.Title: Access to Project Documentation
International Coders.Description: Provide coders with access to all relevant project documentation, including requirements, epics, stories, and tasks. This will ensure they have all the information needed to complete their tasks efficiently.

User Stories.Title: Access Project Documentation
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to access all relevant project documentation including requirements, epics, stories, and tasks so that I can understand the project scope and complete my tasks efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the project documentation section, then I should see a list of all relevant project documents.
Given I click on a specific document, when the document loads, then I should be able to view its content in a readable format.

User Stories.Title: Search Project Documentation
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to search through project documentation so that I can quickly find specific information related to my tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the project documentation page, when I enter a keyword in the search bar, then I should see a list of documents containing that keyword.
Given I select a document from the search results, when the document loads, then the keyword should be highlighted within the document.

User Stories.Title: Filter Project Documentation by Type
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to filter project documentation by type (e.g., requirements, epics, stories, tasks) so that I can easily find the specific type of document I need.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the project documentation page, when I select a document type filter, then I should see a list of documents of that type.
Given I have applied a filter, when I clear the filter, then I should see the full list of project documents again.

User Stories.Title: Download Project Documentation
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to download project documentation so that I can access it offline and refer to it as needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a project document, when I click the download button, then the document should be downloaded to my local device in a readable format (e.g., PDF).

User Stories.Title: Comment on Project Documentation
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to comment on project documentation so that I can ask questions or provide feedback on specific sections.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a project document, when I highlight a section and click the comment button, then I should be able to add a comment to that section.
Given I have added a comment, when another user views the document, then they should see my comment and be able to reply.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Documentation Updates
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to receive notifications when project documentation is updated so that I am aware of any changes that might affect my tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am subscribed to a project, when any document within the project is updated, then I should receive a notification with details of the update.
Given I receive a notification, when I click on it, then I should be taken to the updated document.

User Stories.Title: Access Task Assignments
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to access my task assignments so that I can see what tasks I need to complete and their deadlines.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the task assignments section, then I should see a list of tasks assigned to me.
Given I click on a task, when the task details load, then I should see the task description, deadline, and any related documentation.

User Stories.Title: Update Task Status
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to update the status of my tasks so that project managers can see my progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing my task list, when I select a task and update its status (e.g., In Progress, Completed), then the status should be saved and visible to project managers.

User Stories.Title: View Task Dependencies
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to view task dependencies so that I understand which tasks need to be completed before I can start my work.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a task, when I check its dependencies, then I should see a list of tasks that must be completed before this task can start.

User Stories.Title: Time Tracking for Tasks
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to track the time I spend on each task so that accurate billing and project tracking can be maintained.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I start working on a task, when I click the start timer button, then the system should begin tracking my time.
Given I finish working on a task, when I click the stop timer button, then the system should stop tracking my time and save the duration.

International Coders.Title: Performance and Progress Tracking
International Coders.Description: Create a dashboard for coders to view their performance metrics, track their progress on tasks, and receive feedback. This will help them stay on track and improve their productivity.

User Stories.Title: View Performance Metrics
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to view my performance metrics on the dashboard so that I can understand my productivity and areas for improvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays key performance metrics such as tasks completed, average time per task, and overall productivity score.
Metrics are updated in real-time or at regular intervals.
The dashboard is accessible via a secure login.

User Stories.Title: Track Task Progress
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to track my progress on assigned tasks so that I can manage my workload effectively and meet deadlines.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard shows a list of all assigned tasks with their current status (e.g., Not Started, In Progress, Completed).
Each task entry includes details such as task description, start date, due date, and time spent.
Tasks can be filtered and sorted by status, priority, and due date.

User Stories.Title: Receive Feedback
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to receive feedback on my completed tasks so that I can improve my skills and performance.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes a section for feedback on completed tasks.
Feedback entries include the task name, feedback date, and detailed comments from the reviewer.
Coders receive notifications when new feedback is available.

User Stories.Title: Set Personal Goals
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to set personal goals on the dashboard so that I can track my progress towards achieving them.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard allows coders to set and edit personal goals.
Goals include a description, target date, and progress tracking.
Coders receive reminders and notifications related to their goals.

User Stories.Title: View Historical Performance Data
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to view my historical performance data so that I can analyze my long-term progress and trends.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard provides access to historical performance data, including past tasks and metrics.
Data can be viewed by week, month, and year.
Historical data includes visualizations such as charts and graphs for better analysis.

User Stories.Title: Access Learning Resources
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to access learning resources from the dashboard so that I can improve my skills and knowledge.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes a section for learning resources such as tutorials, articles, and videos.
Resources are categorized by topic and skill level.
Coders can bookmark and track their progress on learning resources.

User Stories.Title: Receive Task Notifications
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to receive notifications for new tasks and updates so that I can stay informed and manage my workload efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard sends notifications for new task assignments, updates, and deadlines.
Notifications are customizable based on coder preferences (e.g., email, in-app).
Coders can view a history of notifications on the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Collaborate with Team Members
User Stories.Description: As an International Coder, I want to collaborate with team members through the dashboard so that we can work together efficiently on tasks and projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes collaboration tools such as messaging, file sharing, and task comments.
Coders can see which team members are assigned to the same tasks.
Collaboration history is maintained for reference.

Social Media Managers.Title: Automated Twitter Management
Social Media Managers.Description: Develop the Myte Twitter tool to research recent AI news, create daily tweet threads, and post them on the company's Twitter account. This tool will ensure consistent and engaging content is shared with the audience.

User Stories.Title: Research Recent AI News
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to automatically research recent AI news so that I can stay updated with the latest trends and share relevant content.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should fetch recent AI news from multiple reliable sources.
The tool should categorize news based on relevance and recency.
The tool should provide a summary of each news article.

User Stories.Title: Generate Daily Tweet Threads
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to generate daily tweet threads based on the researched AI news so that I can maintain a consistent posting schedule.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should create a tweet thread with a minimum of 3 tweets and a maximum of 10 tweets.
Each tweet should include a summary of the news, a link to the full article, and relevant hashtags.
The tool should ensure that the tweet thread is coherent and engaging.

User Stories.Title: Schedule Tweets
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to schedule the tweet threads to be posted at optimal times so that I can maximize audience engagement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should allow setting specific times for posting tweet threads.
The tool should suggest optimal posting times based on historical engagement data.
The tool should notify the user before posting the scheduled tweets.

User Stories.Title: Post Tweets to Twitter Account
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to automatically post the tweet threads to the company's Twitter account so that I can save time and ensure timely updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should authenticate with the company's Twitter account using OAuth.
The tool should post the tweet threads at the scheduled times.
The tool should log each posted tweet thread for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Monitor Tweet Performance
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to monitor the performance of the posted tweet threads so that I can understand their impact and adjust future content strategies.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should track metrics such as likes, retweets, comments, and impressions for each tweet thread.
The tool should generate a weekly performance report.
The tool should provide insights and recommendations based on the performance data.

User Stories.Title: Edit Generated Tweet Threads
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the ability to review and edit the generated tweet threads before they are posted so that I can ensure the content aligns with our brand voice.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should provide an interface to review the generated tweet threads.
The tool should allow editing of the tweet content, hashtags, and links.
The tool should save the edited version and use it for posting.

User Stories.Title: Handle Errors and Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to handle errors gracefully and notify me of any issues so that I can take corrective actions promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should log any errors encountered during research, generation, scheduling, or posting.
The tool should send notifications via email or SMS in case of critical errors.
The tool should provide a user-friendly error message and suggest possible solutions.

Social Media Managers.Title: LinkedIn Outreach Automation
Social Media Managers.Description: Implement the Myte Social LinkedIn tool to manage the LinkedIn CRM, analyze profiles, and send 30 personalized messages daily. This will help in maintaining and expanding professional connections on LinkedIn.

User Stories.Title: LinkedIn CRM Initialization
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to initialize the LinkedIn CRM by importing existing LinkedIn contacts so that I have a comprehensive database to manage and interact with.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the LinkedIn account credentials, when the system is initialized, then it should import all existing LinkedIn contacts into the CRM.
The imported contacts should include details such as Name, Company, Position, and Contact Information.
The system should display a confirmation message once the import is complete.

User Stories.Title: Profile Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to analyze LinkedIn profiles so that I can understand the background and interests of my contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contact in the CRM, when I select the contact, then the system should display an analysis of the contact's LinkedIn profile.
The analysis should include information such as recent posts, shared articles, and mutual connections.
The system should highlight key interests and professional achievements of the contact.

User Stories.Title: Personalized Message Crafting
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to craft personalized messages based on profile analysis so that my outreach is relevant and engaging.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contact's profile analysis, when I choose to send a message, then the system should generate a personalized message template.
The message should include personalized elements such as the contact's name, recent achievements, and shared interests.
The system should allow me to review and edit the message before sending.

User Stories.Title: Daily Message Sending
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to send 30 personalized messages daily so that I can maintain and expand my professional connections efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of contacts, when the daily message sending task is triggered, then the system should send 30 personalized messages to different contacts.
The system should ensure that no contact receives more than one message per day.
The system should log each sent message, including the contact's name, message content, and timestamp.

User Stories.Title: Message History Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to track the history of messages sent to each contact so that I can maintain a record of my interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contact in the CRM, when I view the contact's details, then the system should display a history of all messages sent to that contact.
The message history should include the date, time, and content of each message.
The system should allow me to filter and search the message history by date or keyword.

User Stories.Title: Automated Follow-Up Reminders
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to set automated follow-up reminders based on message responses so that I can stay on top of my outreach efforts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a sent message, when a contact responds, then the system should automatically set a follow-up reminder.
The reminder should be configurable to a specific number of days after the response.
The system should notify me of the follow-up reminder on the specified date.

User Stories.Title: Performance Analytics Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to view a dashboard of my LinkedIn outreach performance so that I can assess the effectiveness of my efforts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the LinkedIn CRM data, when I access the dashboard, then the system should display metrics such as the number of messages sent, response rates, and new connections made.
The dashboard should provide visualizations such as charts and graphs to represent the data.
The system should allow me to filter the analytics by date range and specific campaigns.

Social Media Managers.Title: Facebook Outreach Automation
Social Media Managers.Description: Create the Myte Social Facebook tool to manage the Facebook CRM, analyze profiles, and send 30 personalized messages daily. This will enhance engagement and outreach on Facebook.

User Stories.Title: Import Facebook Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to import my Facebook contacts into the Myte Social Facebook tool so that I can manage my CRM efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the Myte Social Facebook tool, when I click on 'Import Contacts', then my Facebook contacts should be imported into the CRM.
Imported contacts should include Name, Profile Picture, and Contact Information.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Facebook Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to analyze Facebook profiles so that I can gain insights and personalize my outreach.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have imported contacts, when I select a contact, then the tool should display an analysis of their profile including interests, recent activities, and mutual connections.
The analysis should be generated using OpenAI GPT-4o.

User Stories.Title: Send Personalized Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to send 30 personalized messages daily to my Facebook contacts so that I can enhance engagement and outreach.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have analyzed profiles, when I click on 'Send Message', then the tool should generate a personalized message for the selected contact.
The message should include the contact's name and reference their interests or recent activities.
The tool should track the number of messages sent and ensure it does not exceed 30 messages per day.

User Stories.Title: Track Message History
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to track the history of messages sent to each contact so that I can maintain a record of my interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have sent messages, when I view a contact's profile, then I should see a history of all messages sent to that contact.
The history should include the date, time, and content of each message.

User Stories.Title: Automate Message Scheduling
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to schedule messages to be sent at specific times so that I can optimize engagement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have composed a message, when I select a date and time for sending, then the message should be sent automatically at the scheduled time.
The tool should provide a calendar view for scheduling messages.

User Stories.Title: Generate Engagement Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to generate reports on engagement metrics so that I can measure the effectiveness of my outreach.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have sent messages, when I click on 'Generate Report', then the tool should provide a report on engagement metrics such as response rate, click-through rate, and message open rate.
The report should be exportable in PDF format.

User Stories.Title: Sync with Facebook API
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to sync with the Facebook API so that my contact information and messages are always up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the Myte Social Facebook tool, when I click on 'Sync', then the tool should update my contacts and message history from Facebook.
The sync process should run automatically at regular intervals (e.g., daily).

User Stories.Title: Manage Contact Segments
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to segment my contacts into different groups so that I can target my messages more effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have imported contacts, when I create a new segment, then I should be able to add contacts to the segment based on criteria such as interests, location, or engagement level.
The tool should allow me to send messages to specific segments.

User Stories.Title: Provide Message Templates
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to use message templates so that I can save time and ensure consistency in my outreach.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am composing a message, when I select a template, then the message content should be pre-filled with the template text.
The tool should allow me to create, edit, and delete message templates.

User Stories.Title: Monitor Message Performance
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to monitor the performance of my messages so that I can identify which messages are most effective.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have sent messages, when I view the message performance dashboard, then I should see metrics such as open rate, response rate, and click-through rate for each message.
The dashboard should provide visualizations such as charts and graphs.

Social Media Managers.Title: Automated Article Writing and Posting
Social Media Managers.Description: Develop the Myte Researcher tool to collect news on given topics, allow user input, and craft articles with embedded sources and catchy titles. The tool will post these articles to LinkedIn, Twitter, and the personal website, ensuring regular and informative content updates.

User Stories.Title: Collect News on Given Topics
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to collect news on given topics so that I can stay informed and create relevant content.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool allows the user to input specific topics and timeframes for news collection.
The tool fetches news articles from pre-defined sources based on the given topics and timeframe.
The collected news is displayed in an organized manner for easy review.

User Stories.Title: Allow User Input for Article Crafting
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to input my thoughts and insights so that the articles reflect my perspective and expertise.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool provides a text input area for the user to add their thoughts and insights.
The user input is integrated seamlessly into the article content.
The tool allows editing and previewing of the article before finalizing.

User Stories.Title: Craft Articles with Embedded Sources
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to craft articles with embedded sources so that the content is credible and well-supported.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool automatically embeds sources and references within the article.
The sources are clearly cited and linked within the article content.
The tool ensures that all embedded sources are relevant and accurate.

User Stories.Title: Generate Catchy Titles for Articles
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to generate catchy titles for articles so that they attract more readers.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool provides multiple title suggestions based on the article content.
The titles are engaging and relevant to the article's topic.
The user can select and customize the title before publishing.

User Stories.Title: Post Articles to LinkedIn
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to post articles to LinkedIn so that my professional network is regularly updated with new content.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool connects to the user's LinkedIn account securely.
The tool allows scheduling or immediate posting of articles to LinkedIn.
The user receives confirmation once the article is successfully posted.

User Stories.Title: Post Articles to Twitter
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to post articles to Twitter so that my followers are regularly updated with new content.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool connects to the user's Twitter account securely.
The tool allows scheduling or immediate posting of articles to Twitter.
The user receives confirmation once the article is successfully posted.

User Stories.Title: Post Articles to Personal Website
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to post articles to my personal website so that my site remains active and engaging.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool integrates with the user's personal website platform.
The tool allows scheduling or immediate posting of articles to the personal website.
The user receives confirmation once the article is successfully posted.

User Stories.Title: Ensure Regular Content Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the tool to ensure regular content updates so that my audience remains engaged and informed.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool provides options for setting up a content posting schedule.
The tool sends reminders or notifications for upcoming posts.
The tool tracks and reports on the posting schedule adherence.

Social Media Managers.Title: Social Media Analytics Dashboard
Social Media Managers.Description: Create a dashboard to track the performance of social media posts and outreach activities. This will provide insights into engagement metrics, helping social media managers optimize their strategies.

User Stories.Title: View Overall Engagement Metrics
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to view overall engagement metrics for all social media posts so that I can understand the general performance and trends.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I select the 'Overall Engagement' tab, then I should see metrics like total likes, comments, shares, and impressions for all posts.
The metrics should be displayed in a graphical format (e.g., bar chart, line graph) for easy understanding.

User Stories.Title: Filter Engagement Metrics by Platform
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to filter engagement metrics by social media platform so that I can analyze performance on specific platforms like Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I select a specific platform from a dropdown menu, then I should see engagement metrics only for that platform.
The metrics should update dynamically based on the selected platform.

User Stories.Title: Track Post Performance Over Time
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to track the performance of individual posts over time so that I can identify trends and the impact of specific posts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I select a specific post, then I should see a time series graph showing metrics like likes, comments, and shares over time.
The graph should allow me to zoom in and out to view different time ranges.

User Stories.Title: Compare Engagement Metrics Across Posts
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to compare engagement metrics across multiple posts so that I can identify which types of content perform best.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I select multiple posts, then I should see a comparative analysis of engagement metrics for those posts.
The comparison should be displayed in a format that allows easy side-by-side evaluation (e.g., bar chart, table).

User Stories.Title: Export Engagement Data
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to export engagement data to a CSV file so that I can perform further analysis or share it with stakeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I click the 'Export' button, then I should be able to download a CSV file containing the engagement metrics for the selected time period and platform.
The CSV file should include columns for post ID, date, likes, comments, shares, and impressions.

User Stories.Title: Receive Automated Performance Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to receive automated performance reports via email so that I can stay updated on engagement metrics without logging into the dashboard.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have set up email notifications, when a new report is generated, then I should receive an email with a summary of the engagement metrics.
The email should include a link to view the full report on the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Set Engagement Goals and Alerts
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to set engagement goals and receive alerts when metrics exceed or fall below these goals so that I can take timely actions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I set an engagement goal for a specific metric (e.g., likes, comments), then I should receive an alert if the metric exceeds or falls below the set goal.
The alert should be sent via email and displayed as a notification on the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Integrate with Social Media APIs
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the dashboard to integrate with social media APIs so that engagement metrics are updated in real-time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the dashboard is integrated with social media APIs, when I post new content, then the engagement metrics should be updated in real-time on the dashboard.
The integration should support platforms like Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook.

User Stories.Title: View Top Performing Posts
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to view a list of top-performing posts so that I can replicate successful strategies.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I navigate to the 'Top Performing Posts' section, then I should see a ranked list of posts based on engagement metrics.
The list should include metrics like likes, comments, shares, and impressions for each post.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Audience Demographics
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want to analyze audience demographics for my social media posts so that I can tailor content to my audience.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the dashboard, when I select the 'Audience Demographics' tab, then I should see demographic information like age, gender, and location for my audience.
The demographic data should be displayed in a graphical format (e.g., pie chart, bar graph) for easy understanding.

Social Media Managers.Title: Human-like Social Media Operations
Social Media Managers.Description: Implement features to ensure that automated tasks, such as posting articles and sending messages, are performed in a human-like manner. This will help avoid detection as automated behavior by social media platforms.

User Stories.Title: Simulate Human-like Timing for Social Media Posts
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to post articles and messages at varied intervals so that the timing of posts appears human-like and avoids detection as automated behavior.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should randomly vary the posting times within a specified time window.
The system should ensure no two posts are made at exactly the same interval.
The system should log the actual posting times for review.

User Stories.Title: Randomize Content Structure
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to randomize the structure of messages and articles so that the content appears unique and human-generated.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should use different templates for structuring messages and articles.
The system should vary the order of sentences and paragraphs in the content.
The system should include natural language variations and synonyms.

User Stories.Title: Simulate Typing Speed for Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to simulate human typing speed when sending messages so that the sending process appears natural.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should introduce random delays between typing each character.
The system should simulate occasional pauses as if the user is thinking.
The system should log the simulated typing speed for review.

User Stories.Title: Human-like Interaction Patterns
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to simulate human-like interaction patterns such as liking, commenting, and sharing posts at varied intervals so that the interactions appear genuine.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should randomly vary the timing of interactions within a specified time window.
The system should ensure interactions are not performed in a predictable pattern.
The system should log the interaction times and types for review.

User Stories.Title: Personalized Message Crafting
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to craft personalized messages based on the recipient's profile so that the messages appear thoughtful and human-generated.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should analyze the recipient's profile to gather relevant information.
The system should use the gathered information to personalize the message content.
The system should ensure each message is unique and contextually relevant.

User Stories.Title: Natural Language Processing for Article Writing
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to use advanced natural language processing techniques to write articles that mimic human writing styles so that the articles appear authentic.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should use NLP models to generate article content.
The system should ensure the articles have a natural flow and coherence.
The system should include variations in sentence structure and vocabulary.

User Stories.Title: Simulate Human-like Browsing Behavior
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to simulate human-like browsing behavior before posting or interacting so that the activity appears natural.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should randomly browse through social media feeds and profiles before performing actions.
The system should introduce random delays and pauses during browsing.
The system should log the browsing patterns for review.

User Stories.Title: Monitor and Adjust for Detection Patterns
User Stories.Description: As a Social Media Manager, I want the system to monitor social media platform responses and adjust behaviors to avoid detection as automated activity so that the system remains effective.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should monitor for any warnings or restrictions from social media platforms.
The system should adjust posting and interaction patterns based on detected platform responses.
The system should log any adjustments made for review.

Accounting Team.Title: Automated Invoicing System
Accounting Team.Description: Develop a system to prepare invoices based on account/contact information and hours spent by activity. Integrate the invoicing system with the accounting module to ensure seamless financial tracking and reporting.

User Stories.Title: Generate Invoice from Account Information
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to generate an invoice using account and contact information so that I can bill clients accurately for the services provided.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an account and contact information, when I select the 'Generate Invoice' option, then an invoice should be created with the relevant client details.
The invoice should include the client's name, address, and contact information.

User Stories.Title: Calculate Hours Spent by Activity
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to calculate the hours spent on each activity so that I can accurately bill clients based on the time spent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of activities and their respective time logs, when I generate an invoice, then the system should calculate the total hours spent on each activity.
The calculated hours should be displayed on the invoice next to each activity.

User Stories.Title: Integrate Invoicing with Accounting Module
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the invoicing system to integrate with the accounting module so that financial tracking and reporting are seamless.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invoice is generated, when it is saved, then it should automatically be recorded in the accounting module.
The recorded invoice should include all relevant financial details such as total amount, client information, and date.

User Stories.Title: Monitor Monetary Transactions via TD API
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to monitor monetary transactions via the TD API so that I can keep track of all business financial activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the TD API is connected, when a transaction occurs, then it should be recorded in the accounting module.
The transaction details should include the date, amount, and description.

User Stories.Title: Prepare Documentation for CPA
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to prepare documentation for the CPA so that the financial records can be reviewed and approved.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the financial data is recorded, when I request documentation, then the system should generate a report with all necessary financial details.
The report should be formatted according to CPA requirements and include all transactions, invoices, and financial summaries.

User Stories.Title: Track Invoice Status
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to track the status of invoices so that I can follow up on pending payments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invoice is generated, when it is sent to a client, then its status should be updated to 'Sent'.
When a payment is received, the invoice status should be updated to 'Paid'.

User Stories.Title: Generate Invoice Summary Report
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to generate a summary report of all invoices so that I can review the financial performance over a period.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a date range, when I generate a summary report, then it should include all invoices within that period.
The report should summarize the total amount billed, total amount received, and outstanding amounts.

User Stories.Title: Automate Invoice Sending
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the system to automatically send invoices to clients so that the billing process is efficient and timely.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invoice is generated, when it is ready, then the system should automatically send it to the client's email.
The system should confirm the email was sent and update the invoice status to 'Sent'.

User Stories.Title: Handle Invoice Discrepancies
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to handle discrepancies in invoices so that any errors can be corrected promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invoice is disputed, when a discrepancy is reported, then the system should allow for adjustments to be made.
The adjusted invoice should be re-sent to the client and the status updated accordingly.

User Stories.Title: Secure Access to Invoicing System
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want secure access to the invoicing system so that only authorized personnel can manage financial data.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a user role, when accessing the invoicing system, then the system should verify the user's credentials.
Only authorized users should be able to generate, edit, and send invoices.

Accounting Team.Title: Expense Account Management Mobile App
Accounting Team.Description: Create a mobile application that allows employees to submit expenses by taking pictures of receipts and conversing with an AI system. The app should use a CoT system to analyze conversations and structure expense reports for reimbursement via E-Transfer.

User Stories.Title: Receipt Photo Submission
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to submit expenses by taking pictures of receipts so that I can easily document my expenses for reimbursement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the mobile app is open, when I take a picture of a receipt, then the image should be uploaded to the system.
Given the receipt image is uploaded, when I submit it, then the image should be saved and associated with my expense report.

User Stories.Title: AI Conversation for Expense Details
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to converse with an AI system to provide details about my expenses so that the AI can accurately capture and structure the expense information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the mobile app is open, when I start a conversation with the AI, then the AI should prompt me for necessary expense details.
Given I provide details to the AI, when the conversation ends, then the AI should structure the information and associate it with the receipt image.

User Stories.Title: CoT System Analysis
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want the CoT system to analyze my conversation and extract relevant expense details so that the expense report is accurately structured.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the AI conversation is completed, when the CoT system analyzes the conversation, then it should extract details like date, amount, and category of the expense.
Given the CoT system has extracted details, when the analysis is complete, then the structured expense report should be available for review.

User Stories.Title: Expense Report Review
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to review the structured expense report before submission so that I can ensure all details are correct.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the CoT system has structured the expense report, when I review it, then I should be able to see all extracted details and the associated receipt image.
Given I am reviewing the expense report, when I find an error, then I should be able to edit the details before final submission.

User Stories.Title: Expense Report Submission
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to submit the reviewed expense report for reimbursement so that the accounting team can process my reimbursement via E-Transfer.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have reviewed the expense report, when I submit it, then the report should be sent to the accounting team for processing.
Given the report is submitted, when the accounting team receives it, then they should be notified and able to access the report for reimbursement processing.

User Stories.Title: E-Transfer Reimbursement
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to process the reimbursement via E-Transfer so that employees receive their reimbursements promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an expense report is submitted, when I process it, then the reimbursement should be initiated via E-Transfer.
Given the reimbursement is processed, when the E-Transfer is completed, then the employee should receive a notification of the successful transfer.

User Stories.Title: Expense Report History
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to access the history of submitted expense reports so that I can track and audit reimbursements.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the mobile app is open, when I access the expense report history, then I should see a list of all submitted reports with their statuses.
Given I am viewing the expense report history, when I select a report, then I should see detailed information about that report, including the receipt image and conversation details.

User Stories.Title: Notification System
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive notifications about the status of my expense report so that I am informed about its progress and reimbursement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have submitted an expense report, when the status changes (e.g., received, processed, reimbursed), then I should receive a notification.
Given I receive a notification, when I open it, then I should see the current status and any relevant details about my expense report.

Accounting Team.Title: TD API Integration for Financial Transactions
Accounting Team.Description: Implement a module to connect with the TD API for monitoring business credit card and checking account transactions. Ensure secure and efficient data retrieval to streamline the accounting process and prepare documentation for the CPA.

User Stories.Title: Connect to TD API
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to connect to the TD API so that I can retrieve business credit card and checking account transactions securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must establish a secure connection to the TD API using OAuth 2.0.
The connection should be authenticated and authorized using the company's TD Bank credentials.
The connection must be tested to ensure it retrieves data without errors.

User Stories.Title: Retrieve Business Credit Card Transactions
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to retrieve business credit card transactions from the TD API so that I can monitor and record expenses accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must retrieve all business credit card transactions within a specified date range.
The retrieved transactions should include details such as transaction date, amount, merchant name, and category.
The data should be stored securely in the company's database.

User Stories.Title: Retrieve Business Checking Account Transactions
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to retrieve business checking account transactions from the TD API so that I can monitor and record income and expenses accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must retrieve all business checking account transactions within a specified date range.
The retrieved transactions should include details such as transaction date, amount, payee, and transaction type.
The data should be stored securely in the company's database.

User Stories.Title: Automate Data Retrieval
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the system to automatically retrieve transactions from the TD API at regular intervals so that I always have up-to-date financial data.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must retrieve transactions from the TD API daily at a specified time.
The system should handle any API rate limits and retry if necessary.
The system should log the success or failure of each data retrieval attempt.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Storage
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the retrieved transaction data to be stored securely so that sensitive financial information is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: The transaction data must be encrypted before being stored in the database.
Access to the stored data must be restricted to authorized users only.
The system should comply with relevant data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

User Stories.Title: Generate Financial Reports
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to generate financial reports from the retrieved transaction data so that I can analyze the company's financial performance.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must generate reports summarizing income and expenses for a specified date range.
Reports should include charts and graphs for visual representation of financial data.
Reports must be exportable in PDF and Excel formats.

User Stories.Title: Prepare Documentation for CPA
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to prepare documentation for the CPA using the retrieved transaction data so that the company's financial records can be audited and submitted to the government.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must compile all transaction data for a specified fiscal period.
The compiled data should be formatted according to CPA requirements.
The documentation must be exportable in a format suitable for submission to the CPA (e.g., PDF).

User Stories.Title: User Access Control
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want user access control features so that only authorized personnel can view and manage financial data.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must support role-based access control (RBAC).
Only users with the 'Accounting' role should have access to financial data.
The system should log all access and modification attempts to financial data.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling and Notifications
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the system to handle errors gracefully and notify me of any issues so that I can take corrective action promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must log all errors encountered during data retrieval or processing.
The system should send email notifications to the Accounting Team in case of critical errors.
The system should provide detailed error messages to help diagnose and resolve issues.

Accounting Team.Title: Comprehensive Financial Reporting
Accounting Team.Description: Develop a reporting tool within the accounting module to generate comprehensive financial reports. This includes tracking all monetary transactions, preparing necessary documentation for the CPA, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

User Stories.Title: Track Monetary Transactions
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to track all monetary transactions in real-time so that I can ensure accurate financial records and timely reporting.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should connect to the TD API to fetch transaction data from the business credit card and checking account.
The system should display all transactions in a chronological order with details such as date, amount, and description.
The system should allow filtering transactions by date range, type, and amount.

User Stories.Title: Generate Financial Reports
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to generate comprehensive financial reports so that I can provide accurate financial information to stakeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow the generation of financial reports for specified periods (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annually).
The reports should include summaries of income, expenses, and net profit/loss.
The reports should be exportable in PDF and Excel formats.

User Stories.Title: Prepare Documentation for CPA
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to prepare necessary documentation for the CPA so that I can ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should compile all relevant financial data into a standardized format required by the CPA.
The documentation should include transaction records, financial statements, and any other required financial information.
The system should provide an option to export the documentation in a format suitable for submission to the CPA.

User Stories.Title: Ensure Regulatory Compliance
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to ensure that all financial reports and documentation comply with regulatory requirements so that the company avoids legal issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should include checks to ensure that all financial data adheres to relevant accounting standards and regulations.
The system should alert the user to any discrepancies or potential compliance issues.
The system should provide guidelines and templates for regulatory-compliant reporting.

User Stories.Title: Automate Expense Tracking
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to automate the tracking of expenses so that I can reduce manual data entry and minimize errors.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow employees to submit expenses via a mobile app by taking pictures of receipts and providing descriptions.
The system should use AI to analyze and categorize expenses automatically.
The system should integrate with the main accounting module to update expense records in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Monitor Financial Health
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to monitor the financial health of the company in real-time so that I can make informed financial decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should provide a dashboard displaying key financial metrics such as cash flow, revenue, expenses, and profit margins.
The dashboard should update in real-time as new transactions are recorded.
The system should allow the user to set up alerts for significant changes or anomalies in financial data.

User Stories.Title: Reconcile Accounts
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to reconcile accounts regularly so that I can ensure the accuracy of financial records.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should provide tools for reconciling bank statements with internal transaction records.
The system should highlight any discrepancies between the bank statements and internal records.
The system should allow the user to make adjustments and add notes for any reconciled discrepancies.

User Stories.Title: Generate Tax Reports
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to generate tax reports so that I can ensure timely and accurate tax filings.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should compile all necessary financial data for tax reporting, including income, expenses, and deductions.
The system should generate tax reports in the format required by tax authorities.
The system should provide options to export tax reports for submission.

User Stories.Title: Audit Trail
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to maintain an audit trail of all financial transactions so that I can ensure transparency and accountability.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should log all financial transactions with details such as date, time, user, and action taken.
The audit trail should be immutable and accessible only to authorized users.
The system should allow the user to generate audit reports for specified periods.

User Stories.Title: Budget Management
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to manage budgets for different departments so that I can control spending and ensure financial discipline.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow the creation and management of budgets for different departments and projects.
The system should track actual spending against the budget and provide alerts for any overages.
The system should generate budget reports showing planned vs. actual spending.

Accounting Team.Title: Automated Expense Analysis and Reimbursement
Accounting Team.Description: Create an automated system to analyze submitted expenses and process reimbursements. This system should ensure accurate categorization of expenses and streamline the reimbursement process via E-Transfer.

User Stories.Title: Expense Submission via Mobile App
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to submit my expenses by taking pictures of receipts and talking to an AI system so that I can easily report my expenses for reimbursement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app allows users to take clear pictures of receipts.
The app supports voice input for describing expenses.
The app stores the receipt images and voice inputs securely.

User Stories.Title: AI-Based Expense Categorization
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want the AI system to analyze submitted expenses and categorize them accurately so that I can ensure proper accounting and reimbursement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system categorizes expenses based on predefined categories (e.g., travel, meals, office supplies).
The categorization accuracy is at least 95%.
The system flags any ambiguous or unclear expenses for manual review.

User Stories.Title: Expense Report Generation
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want the system to generate structured expense reports from the analyzed data so that I can review and approve expenses efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system generates expense reports in a standardized format.
Reports include categorized expenses, receipt images, and voice input transcriptions.
Reports are available for download in PDF format.

User Stories.Title: E-Transfer Reimbursement Processing
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want the system to process reimbursements via E-Transfer so that employees can receive their reimbursements quickly and securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system integrates with the company's banking API to initiate E-Transfers.
Reimbursements are processed within 24 hours of report approval.
Employees receive a notification once the reimbursement is processed.

User Stories.Title: Expense Report Approval Workflow
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want a workflow for reviewing and approving expense reports so that I can ensure all expenses are valid and properly categorized before reimbursement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system provides a dashboard for reviewing submitted expense reports.
Reports can be approved or rejected with comments.
Approved reports trigger the reimbursement process.

User Stories.Title: Expense Report Audit Trail
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want an audit trail for all expense reports so that I can track changes and approvals for compliance purposes.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system logs all actions taken on expense reports (submission, categorization, approval, rejection).
Audit logs include timestamps and user details.
Audit logs are accessible for review and export.

User Stories.Title: Expense Data Analytics
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to analyze expense data to identify trends and anomalies so that I can make informed financial decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system provides analytics dashboards with visualizations of expense data.
Dashboards include filters for date range, category, and employee.
The system highlights any unusual spending patterns or anomalies.

User Stories.Title: User Notifications for Expense Status
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive notifications about the status of my submitted expenses so that I am informed about the progress and approval of my reimbursements.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system sends notifications for expense submission, approval, rejection, and reimbursement processing.
Notifications are sent via email and mobile app push notifications.
Notification messages are clear and provide relevant details.

Accounting Team.Title: Secure Data Storage and Backup
