Accounting Team.Description: Implement robust security measures for storing financial data on AWS. Ensure regular backups and data encryption to protect sensitive financial information and comply with data privacy regulations.

User Stories.Title: Encrypt Financial Data in Transit and at Rest
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want all financial data to be encrypted both in transit and at rest so that sensitive financial information is protected from unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: Financial data is encrypted using industry-standard encryption algorithms (e.g., AES-256) when stored on AWS.
Data transmitted between the application and AWS is encrypted using HTTPS.
Encryption keys are managed securely using AWS Key Management Service (KMS).

User Stories.Title: Implement Regular Data Backups
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want regular backups of all financial data to be performed so that data can be restored in case of data loss or corruption.
AcceptanceCriteria: Financial data is backed up daily to a secure AWS S3 bucket.
Backups are retained for a minimum of 30 days.
A process is in place to verify the integrity of backups.
Automated alerts are generated if a backup fails.

User Stories.Title: Access Control for Financial Data
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want access to financial data to be restricted to authorized personnel only so that sensitive information is not exposed to unauthorized users.
AcceptanceCriteria: Role-based access control (RBAC) is implemented to restrict access to financial data.
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for accessing financial data.
Access logs are maintained and reviewed regularly to detect unauthorized access attempts.

User Stories.Title: Audit Trail for Financial Data Access
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want an audit trail of all access to financial data so that any unauthorized access can be detected and investigated.
AcceptanceCriteria: All access to financial data is logged with details including user ID, timestamp, and action performed.
Audit logs are stored securely and are tamper-proof.
Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 1 year.
Automated alerts are generated for suspicious access patterns.

User Stories.Title: Compliance with Data Privacy Regulations
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the system to comply with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) so that the company avoids legal penalties and maintains customer trust.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data encryption and access control measures comply with GDPR and CCPA requirements.
Data retention policies are implemented to ensure data is not kept longer than necessary.
Data subject access requests (DSARs) can be fulfilled within the required timeframes.
Regular audits are conducted to ensure ongoing compliance with data privacy regulations.

User Stories.Title: Disaster Recovery Plan
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want a disaster recovery plan in place so that financial data can be quickly restored in case of a catastrophic event.
AcceptanceCriteria: A documented disaster recovery plan is in place, detailing the steps to restore financial data.
Regular disaster recovery drills are conducted to ensure the plan is effective.
Recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO) are defined and met.
Automated alerts are generated if the disaster recovery plan is activated.

User Stories.Title: Data Anonymization for Non-Production Environments
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want financial data to be anonymized before being used in non-production environments so that sensitive information is not exposed during development and testing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Financial data is anonymized before being copied to non-production environments.
Anonymization techniques comply with data privacy regulations.
Automated processes are in place to ensure data is anonymized consistently.
Access to non-production environments is restricted to authorized personnel only.

Accounting Team.Title: User-Friendly Accounting Dashboard
Accounting Team.Description: Design a user-friendly dashboard for the accounting team to view and manage all financial transactions, invoices, and expense reports. The dashboard should provide real-time updates and easy access to financial data.

User Stories.Title: View Financial Transactions
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to view all financial transactions in a centralized dashboard so that I can easily monitor and manage the company's finances.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays a list of all financial transactions.
Transactions are categorized by type (e.g., income, expenses).
Each transaction shows details such as date, amount, category, and description.
The dashboard allows filtering transactions by date range, category, and amount.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Transaction Updates
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want the dashboard to provide real-time updates on financial transactions so that I can make timely decisions based on the latest data.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard automatically updates with new transactions as they occur.
A notification system alerts the user to new transactions.
The real-time update feature can be toggled on or off by the user.

User Stories.Title: Generate and View Invoices
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to generate and view invoices from the dashboard so that I can manage billing and payments efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard provides an option to create new invoices.
Invoices can be generated based on predefined templates.
The dashboard displays a list of all generated invoices with details such as invoice number, date, client, amount, and status.
Invoices can be filtered by date range, client, and status.

User Stories.Title: Manage Expense Reports
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to manage expense reports from the dashboard so that I can track and approve employee expenses.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays a list of all submitted expense reports.
Each expense report shows details such as employee name, date, total amount, and status.
The dashboard allows filtering expense reports by date range, employee, and status.
The user can approve or reject expense reports directly from the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Financial Data Export
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to export financial data from the dashboard so that I can share it with other stakeholders or use it for further analysis.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard provides an option to export financial data in various formats (e.g., CSV, PDF).
The user can select the data range and type of data to export.
The exported file includes all relevant details and is formatted for easy readability.

User Stories.Title: Dashboard Customization
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to customize the dashboard layout and widgets so that I can tailor the view to my specific needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard allows users to add, remove, and rearrange widgets.
Users can save and load different dashboard layouts.
Customization options include changing the display settings for each widget (e.g., data range, chart type).

User Stories.Title: Access Control and Permissions
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to have access control and permissions in place so that sensitive financial data is protected and only accessible to authorized personnel.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard requires user authentication to access.
Role-based access control (RBAC) is implemented to restrict access to certain features based on user roles.
Users can only view and manage data that they have permission to access.

User Stories.Title: Financial Summary Overview
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to see a financial summary overview on the dashboard so that I can quickly assess the company's financial health.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays key financial metrics such as total income, total expenses, net profit, and cash flow.
The financial summary is updated in real-time.
The summary includes visual representations (e.g., charts, graphs) for easy interpretation.

User Stories.Title: Transaction Search Functionality
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want to search for specific transactions on the dashboard so that I can quickly find and review particular entries.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes a search bar for finding transactions.
Search results are displayed in real-time as the user types.
Users can search by various criteria such as transaction ID, date, amount, and description.

User Stories.Title: Integration with Accounting Software
User Stories.Description: As an accounting team member, I want the dashboard to integrate with our existing accounting software so that data is synchronized and consistent across platforms.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard integrates with the company's accounting software via API.
Financial data is synchronized between the dashboard and the accounting software in real-time.
Users can perform actions (e.g., creating invoices, approving expenses) on the dashboard that are reflected in the accounting software.

Accounting Team.Title: Integration with Project Management System
Accounting Team.Description: Ensure seamless integration between the accounting module and the project management system to accurately track hours spent on tasks and generate corresponding invoices. This integration should facilitate efficient financial tracking and reporting.

User Stories.Title: Track Hours Spent on Tasks
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to track hours spent on tasks in the project management system so that I can accurately generate invoices based on the time logged.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow users to log hours spent on tasks.
Logged hours should be automatically synced with the accounting module.
The system should display a summary of hours logged per task and per project.

User Stories.Title: Generate Invoices Based on Logged Hours
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to generate invoices based on the hours logged in the project management system so that I can ensure accurate billing for clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should generate invoices using the logged hours and predefined hourly rates.
Invoices should include detailed breakdowns of tasks and hours.
Invoices should be stored in the accounting module for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Sync Financial Data with Accounting Module
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want financial data from the project management system to be automatically synced with the accounting module so that I can maintain accurate financial records.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should automatically sync financial data, including logged hours and generated invoices, with the accounting module.
The sync process should occur in real-time or at scheduled intervals.
Any discrepancies between the project management system and accounting module should be flagged for review.

User Stories.Title: Generate Financial Reports
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to generate financial reports based on the data from the project management system so that I can analyze financial performance and make informed decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should generate financial reports, including revenue, expenses, and profit margins.
Reports should be customizable based on date ranges, projects, and clients.
Reports should be exportable in various formats (e.g., PDF, Excel).

User Stories.Title: Monitor Invoice Status
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to monitor the status of invoices generated from the project management system so that I can track payments and follow up with clients if necessary.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should display the status of each invoice (e.g., sent, paid, overdue).
The system should send automated reminders for overdue invoices.
The system should allow manual updates to invoice status.

User Stories.Title: Integrate with TD API for Financial Transactions
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the accounting module to integrate with the TD API so that I can monitor business credit card and checking account transactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should securely connect to the TD API to fetch transaction data.
Fetched transaction data should be automatically categorized and linked to relevant projects or expenses.
The system should generate reports on financial transactions for review and reconciliation.

User Stories.Title: Expense Management Integration
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want the expense management system to integrate with the accounting module so that I can process and reimburse employee expenses efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow employees to submit expenses via the mobile app.
Submitted expenses should be automatically synced with the accounting module.
The system should generate reimbursement reports and facilitate e-transfer payments.

User Stories.Title: Ensure Data Security and Compliance
User Stories.Description: As an Accounting Team member, I want to ensure that all financial data is secure and compliant with relevant regulations so that I can protect sensitive information and avoid legal issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should use encryption for data storage and transmission.
The system should implement role-based access control to restrict access to financial data.
The system should provide audit logs of all financial transactions and data access.

Employees.Title: Employee Digital Profile Management
Employees.Description: Develop a comprehensive system to maintain digital profiles for all employees, including personal information, job roles, and relevant tracking data. This will enable Project Managers (PMs) to manage all aspects of employee data efficiently.

User Stories.Title: Create Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to create my digital profile so that my personal information, job role, and relevant tracking data are accurately recorded.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the profile creation page, I should be able to input my personal information, job role, and other relevant data.
When I submit the form, my profile should be saved in the system and accessible for future updates.

User Stories.Title: Update Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to update my digital profile so that my information remains current and accurate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to my profile page, I should see an option to edit my information.
When I make changes and submit the form, my profile should be updated in the system.

User Stories.Title: View Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to view my digital profile so that I can verify my personal information and job role.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to my profile page, I should see all my personal information, job role, and relevant tracking data displayed accurately.

User Stories.Title: Track Task Completion
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to log the start and end times of my tasks so that my work hours can be tracked accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am assigned a task, when I start working on it, I should be able to log the start time.
When I finish the task, I should be able to log the end time.
The system should calculate the total time spent on the task and update my profile with this information.

User Stories.Title: Submit Expense Reports
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to submit my expenses via a mobile app so that I can get reimbursed efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have the mobile app installed, when I take a picture of a receipt and provide details via voice input, the system should analyze and structure the expense report.
The expense report should be submitted for processing and reimbursement.

User Stories.Title: View Task History
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to view my task history so that I can see all the tasks I have completed and the time spent on each.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to my profile page, I should see a section for task history.
The task history should display all tasks I have completed, along with the start and end times and total time spent on each task.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Task Assignments
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive notifications when new tasks are assigned to me so that I can start working on them promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when a new task is assigned to me, I should receive a notification.
The notification should include details about the task and a link to start working on it.

User Stories.Title: Access Company Policies and Guidelines
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to access company policies and guidelines so that I can ensure my work complies with company standards.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the resources section, I should see a list of company policies and guidelines.
I should be able to view and download these documents as needed.

User Stories.Title: Request Time Off
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to request time off through the system so that my leave can be tracked and approved efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the time off request page, I should be able to submit a request for leave.
The system should notify my manager for approval, and I should receive a notification once my request is approved or denied.

User Stories.Title: View Performance Reviews
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to view my performance reviews so that I can understand my strengths and areas for improvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to my profile page, I should see a section for performance reviews.
The performance reviews should display feedback from my manager and any relevant metrics or scores.

Employees.Title: Task Assignment and Tracking
Employees.Description: Implement a robust task management system that allows PMs to assign tasks to employees, track task progress, and monitor time spent on each task. This will ensure efficient task distribution and accountability.

User Stories.Title: Task Assignment Notification
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to receive notifications when a new task is assigned to me so that I am immediately aware of my responsibilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when a PM assigns a task to me, then I should receive a notification.
The notification should include the task title, description, and due date.

User Stories.Title: View Assigned Tasks
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to view a list of all tasks assigned to me so that I can manage my workload effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the 'My Tasks' section, then I should see a list of all tasks assigned to me.
Each task should display the title, description, due date, and status.

User Stories.Title: Start Task
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to start a task so that my time spent on the task can be tracked.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a task assigned to me, when I click the 'Start Task' button, then the system should begin tracking the time spent on the task.
The task status should change to 'In Progress'.

User Stories.Title: End Task
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to end a task so that the system stops tracking the time spent on the task.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am working on a task, when I click the 'End Task' button, then the system should stop tracking the time spent on the task.
The task status should change to 'Completed'.

User Stories.Title: Update Task Progress
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to update the progress of a task so that the PM can monitor the task status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a task assigned to me, when I update the progress percentage, then the system should save the updated progress.
The updated progress should be visible to the PM.

User Stories.Title: Log Time Spent on Task
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to log the time spent on a task manually so that I can ensure accurate time tracking.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a task assigned to me, when I enter the time spent on the task, then the system should save the logged time.
The logged time should be added to the total time spent on the task.

User Stories.Title: View Task Details
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to view detailed information about a task so that I understand the requirements and expectations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a list of tasks assigned to me, when I click on a task, then I should see detailed information including the task title, description, due date, and any attached files or links.

User Stories.Title: Attach Files to Task
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to attach files to a task so that I can share relevant documents and resources with the PM.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a task assigned to me, when I upload a file, then the system should attach the file to the task.
The attached file should be accessible to the PM and other relevant stakeholders.

User Stories.Title: Comment on Task
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to add comments to a task so that I can communicate updates or issues to the PM.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a task assigned to me, when I add a comment, then the system should save the comment and notify the PM.
The comment should be visible in the task's comment history.

User Stories.Title: View Task History
User Stories.Description: As an Employee, I want to view the history of a task so that I can see all updates, comments, and time logs associated with it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a task assigned to me, when I navigate to the task history, then I should see a chronological list of all updates, comments, and time logs.

Employees.Title: Expense Submission and Management
Employees.Description: Create a mobile application that enables employees to submit expenses by taking pictures of receipts and conversing with an AI system. The AI will analyze the conversations and structure the expense reports for reimbursement via E-Transfer.

User Stories.Title: Capture Receipt Image
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to capture an image of my receipt using the mobile app so that I can submit it for expense reimbursement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should have a camera feature to capture receipt images.
The captured image should be clear and legible.
The app should allow the user to retake the image if it is not satisfactory.

User Stories.Title: Upload Receipt Image
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to upload an image of my receipt from my phone's gallery so that I can submit it for expense reimbursement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should allow users to select and upload images from their phone's gallery.
The uploaded image should be clear and legible.
The app should confirm successful upload of the image.

User Stories.Title: Voice Input for Expense Details
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to provide expense details by talking to an AI system so that I can easily describe my expenses without typing.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should have a voice input feature to capture spoken expense details.
The AI system should accurately transcribe the spoken input into text.
The app should display the transcribed text for user confirmation and editing if necessary.

User Stories.Title: AI Analysis of Expense Details
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want the AI system to analyze my spoken expense details so that it can automatically structure the expense report.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should analyze the transcribed text to identify key expense details (e.g., date, amount, category).
The app should display the structured expense report for user review.
The user should be able to edit any incorrectly identified details before submission.

User Stories.Title: Submit Expense Report
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to submit my structured expense report for reimbursement so that I can get reimbursed for my expenses.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should have a submit button to send the expense report for processing.
The app should confirm successful submission of the expense report.
The app should notify the user of any errors or missing information before submission.

User Stories.Title: Track Expense Report Status
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to track the status of my submitted expense reports so that I know when I will be reimbursed.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should display a list of submitted expense reports with their current status (e.g., pending, approved, reimbursed).
The app should provide notifications for status updates.
The user should be able to view detailed information about each expense report.

User Stories.Title: Receive E-Transfer Reimbursement
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive my reimbursement via E-Transfer so that I can get my money quickly and securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should securely collect the user's banking information for E-Transfer.
The app should notify the user when the reimbursement has been processed and sent.
The app should provide a confirmation message once the E-Transfer is complete.

User Stories.Title: Expense Report History
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to view my past expense reports so that I can keep track of my previous reimbursements.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should display a history of all submitted expense reports.
The user should be able to filter and search the expense report history by date, category, or status.
The app should provide detailed information for each past expense report.

User Stories.Title: Edit Expense Report
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to edit my expense report before submission so that I can correct any mistakes or add missing information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should allow users to edit any part of the expense report before submission.
The app should save changes and update the report in real-time.
The app should provide a preview of the final report before submission.

User Stories.Title: Help and Support
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want access to help and support within the mobile app so that I can resolve any issues or questions about submitting expenses.
AcceptanceCriteria: The mobile app should have a help section with FAQs and guides on using the expense submission features.
The app should provide contact information for support if the user needs further assistance.
The app should offer a chatbot for quick answers to common questions.

Employees.Title: Project Kick-Off and Execution
Employees.Description: Develop a system to distribute project tasks to international coders, allowing them to start and end tasks while tracking the time spent. This will compile time data by contract/coder for invoicing and project management purposes.

User Stories.Title: Task Assignment Interface
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to assign tasks to international coders so that they can start working on specific project tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of tasks, when I select a task, then I should be able to assign it to a specific coder.
When a task is assigned, then the coder should receive a notification with task details.

User Stories.Title: Start Task Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a Coder, I want to start a task so that my time spent on the task is tracked from the moment I begin.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an assigned task, when I click 'Start Task', then the system should begin tracking the time spent on the task.
When the task is started, then the task status should be updated to 'In Progress'.

User Stories.Title: End Task Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a Coder, I want to end a task so that the system stops tracking the time spent on the task.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a task in progress, when I click 'End Task', then the system should stop tracking the time spent on the task.
When the task is ended, then the task status should be updated to 'Completed'.

User Stories.Title: Time Tracking Summary
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view a summary of time spent by each coder on tasks so that I can manage project progress and invoicing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a project, when I view the time tracking summary, then I should see the total time spent by each coder on their assigned tasks.
The summary should include details such as task name, coder name, start time, end time, and total hours spent.

User Stories.Title: Task Status Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view the status of all tasks so that I can monitor project progress in real-time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a project, when I access the task status dashboard, then I should see the current status of all tasks (e.g., Not Started, In Progress, Completed).
The dashboard should allow filtering tasks by status, coder, and contract.

User Stories.Title: Notification System
User Stories.Description: As a Coder, I want to receive notifications when a task is assigned to me so that I am aware of new tasks promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new task assignment, when a task is assigned to a coder, then the coder should receive a notification with task details.
The notification should include task name, description, and deadline.

User Stories.Title: Task Details View
User Stories.Description: As a Coder, I want to view detailed information about my assigned tasks so that I understand what is required.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an assigned task, when I view the task details, then I should see the task name, description, deadline, and any relevant files or links.
The task details should be easily accessible from my task list.

User Stories.Title: Time Tracking Export
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to export time tracking data so that I can use it for invoicing and reporting purposes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a project, when I export the time tracking data, then I should receive a file (e.g., CSV) with detailed time tracking information.
The export should include task name, coder name, start time, end time, and total hours spent.

User Stories.Title: Task Prioritization
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to set the priority of tasks so that coders know which tasks are most urgent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of tasks, when I set the priority of a task, then the task should be marked with the appropriate priority level (e.g., High, Medium, Low).
The priority level should be visible to coders in their task list.

User Stories.Title: Task Comments
User Stories.Description: As a Coder, I want to add comments to tasks so that I can communicate any issues or updates to the Project Manager.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an assigned task, when I add a comment, then the comment should be visible to the Project Manager and other relevant stakeholders.
The comment should include the coder's name, date, and time of the comment.

Employees.Title: Employee Communication and Collaboration
Employees.Description: Implement features that facilitate communication and collaboration among employees, including internal messaging, shared project boards, and document sharing. This will enhance teamwork and project coordination.

User Stories.Title: Internal Messaging System
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want an internal messaging system so that I can communicate with my colleagues in real-time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can send and receive messages in real-time.
Messages can be sent to individuals or groups.
Notifications are received for new messages.
Messages are stored securely and can be retrieved later.

User Stories.Title: Shared Project Boards
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want shared project boards so that I can collaborate on tasks and track project progress with my team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can create, edit, and delete tasks on the project board.
Tasks can be assigned to specific team members.
Tasks can have due dates, descriptions, and status updates.
Project boards are accessible to all team members involved in the project.

User Stories.Title: Document Sharing
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want a document sharing feature so that I can easily share and access project-related documents with my team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can upload, download, and share documents.
Documents can be organized into folders and tagged for easy searching.
Access permissions can be set for different documents and folders.
Version control is implemented to track changes and updates to documents.

User Stories.Title: Task Notifications
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive notifications for task updates so that I am always aware of changes and deadlines.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees receive notifications for task assignments, updates, and deadlines.
Notifications can be customized based on user preferences.
Notifications are sent via email and/or the internal messaging system.

User Stories.Title: Team Calendar Integration
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want a team calendar integration so that I can schedule and view project-related events and deadlines.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can create and view events on a shared team calendar.
Events can be linked to specific projects and tasks.
Reminders and notifications are sent for upcoming events and deadlines.
Calendar is accessible to all team members involved in the project.

User Stories.Title: Collaborative Editing
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want a collaborative editing feature so that multiple team members can work on the same document simultaneously.
AcceptanceCriteria: Multiple employees can edit a document at the same time.
Changes are saved in real-time and visible to all collaborators.
Version history is maintained to track changes and revert to previous versions if needed.
Access permissions can be set for collaborative documents.

User Stories.Title: Discussion Threads
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want discussion threads within project boards so that I can have focused conversations about specific tasks or topics.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can start and participate in discussion threads linked to specific tasks or topics.
Threads are organized and searchable within the project board.
Notifications are sent for new comments and replies in discussion threads.
Threads can be archived or deleted when no longer needed.

User Stories.Title: File Preview
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to preview shared documents and files without downloading them so that I can quickly access information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can preview common file types (e.g., PDFs, images, text files) directly within the document sharing feature.
Previews are generated quickly and accurately.
Access permissions are respected for file previews.
Previews are available for both uploaded and shared documents.

User Stories.Title: Search Functionality
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want a search functionality so that I can quickly find messages, tasks, and documents.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can search for messages, tasks, and documents using keywords.
Search results are displayed quickly and accurately.
Search filters can be applied to narrow down results (e.g., by date, project, or sender).
Search results respect access permissions and only show items the employee is authorized to view.

User Stories.Title: User Profiles
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want user profiles so that I can view and update my contact information, skills, and project involvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Employees can view and update their own user profiles.
Profiles include contact information, skills, and current project involvement.
Profiles are accessible to other employees for collaboration purposes.
Profile updates are saved securely and reflected in real-time.

Employees.Title: Performance and Productivity Tracking
Employees.Description: Create tools to monitor and report on employee performance and productivity, including time tracking, task completion rates, and project contributions. This will help in evaluating employee performance and identifying areas for improvement.

User Stories.Title: Time Tracking System
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to log the start and end times of my tasks so that I can accurately track the time spent on each activity.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows employees to start and stop a timer for each task.
The system records the start and end times along with the total duration for each task.
Employees can view a summary of their logged times for the day, week, and month.

User Stories.Title: Task Completion Rate
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to mark tasks as completed so that I can track my task completion rate.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows employees to mark tasks as completed.
The system calculates the task completion rate based on the number of completed tasks versus assigned tasks.
Employees can view their task completion rate in a dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Project Contribution Overview
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to see a summary of my contributions to different projects so that I can understand my impact.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system provides a summary of tasks completed by the employee for each project.
The system displays the total time spent by the employee on each project.
Employees can view their project contributions in a graphical format (e.g., pie chart, bar graph).

User Stories.Title: Daily Performance Report
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive a daily performance report so that I can review my productivity and identify areas for improvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system generates a daily performance report summarizing time spent, tasks completed, and project contributions.
The report is sent to the employee's email at the end of each day.
The report includes suggestions for improving productivity based on the employee's performance data.

User Stories.Title: Weekly Performance Summary
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive a weekly performance summary so that I can track my progress over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system generates a weekly performance summary including total time spent, tasks completed, and project contributions.
The summary is sent to the employee's email at the end of each week.
The summary includes trends and insights based on the employee's weekly performance data.

User Stories.Title: Task Prioritization
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to prioritize my tasks so that I can focus on the most important ones first.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows employees to assign priority levels to their tasks (e.g., high, medium, low).
Tasks are displayed in order of priority in the employee's task list.
Employees can filter tasks by priority level.

User Stories.Title: Performance Feedback
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive feedback on my performance so that I can improve my productivity and efficiency.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows managers to provide feedback on employee performance.
Employees can view feedback in their performance dashboard.
Feedback includes specific areas for improvement and actionable suggestions.

User Stories.Title: Goal Setting
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to set personal performance goals so that I can work towards improving specific areas.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows employees to set and track personal performance goals.
Employees can view their progress towards goals in their performance dashboard.
The system provides reminders and notifications to help employees stay on track with their goals.

User Stories.Title: Peer Comparison
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to compare my performance with my peers so that I can understand how I am doing relative to others.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system provides anonymized performance data for peer comparison.
Employees can view their performance metrics alongside average metrics for their team or department.
The comparison includes time tracking, task completion rates, and project contributions.

User Stories.Title: Training Recommendations
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive training recommendations based on my performance data so that I can improve my skills.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system analyzes employee performance data to identify skill gaps.
Employees receive personalized training recommendations to address identified gaps.
Training recommendations are accessible through the employee's performance dashboard.

Employees.Title: Training and Onboarding
Employees.Description: Develop a comprehensive training and onboarding module that provides new employees with the necessary resources and guidance to get started with the system. This will include tutorials, documentation, and support for new hires.

User Stories.Title: Create Employee Onboarding Tutorial
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want a step-by-step onboarding tutorial so that I can quickly understand how to use the system and perform my tasks effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tutorial should cover all major functionalities of the system.
The tutorial should include both text and video instructions.
The tutorial should be accessible from the main dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Provide System Documentation
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want access to comprehensive system documentation so that I can refer to it whenever I have questions or need detailed information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The documentation should be searchable and well-organized.
It should cover all system features, including CRM, project management, invoicing, and social media tools.
The documentation should be updated regularly to reflect any changes or new features.

User Stories.Title: Interactive Onboarding Checklist
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want an interactive onboarding checklist so that I can track my progress and ensure I complete all necessary onboarding tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: The checklist should include all onboarding tasks, such as setting up accounts, completing tutorials, and reading documentation.
Each task should be markable as complete.
The checklist should provide links to relevant tutorials and documentation.

User Stories.Title: Access to Support Resources
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want access to support resources so that I can get help quickly if I encounter any issues or have questions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The support resources should include a FAQ section, a helpdesk ticketing system, and a live chat option.
The live chat should be available during business hours.
The helpdesk ticketing system should allow employees to track the status of their queries.

User Stories.Title: Role-Specific Training Modules
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want role-specific training modules so that I can learn the specific functionalities and tools relevant to my job role.
AcceptanceCriteria: The training modules should be tailored to different roles, such as project managers, developers, and social media managers.
Each module should include practical exercises and quizzes to test understanding.
Completion of each module should be tracked and recorded.

User Stories.Title: Onboarding Feedback Form
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want to provide feedback on the onboarding process so that the company can improve it for future hires.
AcceptanceCriteria: The feedback form should be accessible at the end of the onboarding process.
It should include questions about the clarity, usefulness, and completeness of the onboarding materials.
The feedback should be reviewed regularly and used to make improvements.

User Stories.Title: Mentorship Program
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want to be paired with a mentor so that I can have personalized guidance and support during my initial period.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each new employee should be assigned a mentor from their department.
The mentorship program should include regular check-ins and progress reviews.
Mentors should have access to guidelines and resources to help them support new hires effectively.

User Stories.Title: Onboarding Progress Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a new employee, I want a dashboard to track my onboarding progress so that I can see what tasks I have completed and what is still pending.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard should display a progress bar indicating the percentage of onboarding tasks completed.
It should list all pending and completed tasks with due dates.
The dashboard should be accessible from the main employee portal.

Employees.Title: Employee Feedback and Improvement
Employees.Description: Implement a feedback system that allows employees to provide input on the usability and functionality of the software. This feedback will be used to make continuous improvements to the system, ensuring it meets the needs of all users.

User Stories.Title: Submit Feedback on Software Usability
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to submit feedback on the usability of the software so that the development team can make improvements to enhance my user experience.
AcceptanceCriteria: The feedback form should be accessible from the main dashboard.
The form should allow text input for detailed feedback.
The form should include a rating system (e.g., 1 to 5 stars) for overall usability.
The feedback should be stored in a database for review by the development team.

User Stories.Title: Submit Feedback on Software Functionality
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to submit feedback on the functionality of the software so that the development team can address any issues or add new features.
AcceptanceCriteria: The feedback form should be accessible from the main dashboard.
The form should allow text input for detailed feedback on specific functionalities.
The form should include a dropdown menu to categorize the feedback (e.g., bug report, feature request).
The feedback should be stored in a database for review by the development team.

User Stories.Title: View Submitted Feedback
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to view the feedback I have submitted so that I can track the status and see if any actions have been taken.
AcceptanceCriteria: A 'My Feedback' section should be accessible from the main dashboard.
The section should list all feedback submitted by the employee.
Each feedback entry should display the submission date, category, and status (e.g., under review, in progress, resolved).
The employee should be able to click on each entry to view detailed feedback and any responses from the development team.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications on Feedback Status
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to receive notifications when the status of my feedback changes so that I am informed about the progress and any actions taken.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should send an email notification to the employee when the status of their feedback changes.
The notification should include the feedback details and the new status.
The notification should provide a link to the 'My Feedback' section for more information.

User Stories.Title: Provide Anonymous Feedback
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to have the option to submit feedback anonymously so that I can provide honest input without fear of repercussions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The feedback form should include an option to submit feedback anonymously.
Anonymous feedback should not be linked to the employee's profile.
Anonymous feedback should be stored in the same database but marked as anonymous for review by the development team.

User Stories.Title: Categorize Feedback by Priority
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to categorize my feedback by priority (e.g., low, medium, high) so that the development team can prioritize improvements based on urgency.
AcceptanceCriteria: The feedback form should include a dropdown menu to select the priority level.
The priority level should be stored along with the feedback in the database.
The development team should be able to filter and sort feedback by priority level.

User Stories.Title: Track Feedback Resolution Time
User Stories.Description: As an employee, I want to see the average resolution time for feedback so that I can understand how quickly issues are being addressed.
AcceptanceCriteria: The 'My Feedback' section should display the average resolution time for feedback.
The system should calculate the average resolution time based on the time taken to resolve each feedback entry.
The average resolution time should be updated in real-time as feedback is resolved.

Clients.Title: Client Portal Access
Clients.Description: Develop a client portal that allows clients to view their contracts, communications, and project progress. The portal will provide a comprehensive overview of all interactions and project statuses, ensuring transparency and easy access to information.

User Stories.Title: View Contracts
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view all my contracts with the company so that I can easily access and review the terms and conditions at any time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'Contracts' section, then I should see a list of all my contracts.
Each contract should display key details such as contract ID, start date, end date, and status.
I should be able to click on a contract to view its full details.

User Stories.Title: View Communications
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view all communications related to my contracts so that I can keep track of all interactions with the company.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'Communications' section, then I should see a list of all emails and messages related to my contracts.
Each communication should display the sender, date, and a snippet of the message content.
I should be able to click on a communication to view its full content.

User Stories.Title: View Project Progress
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view the progress of my projects so that I can stay updated on the status and milestones.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'Project Progress' section, then I should see a list of all my ongoing projects.
Each project should display key details such as project name, start date, end date, current phase, and percentage completed.
I should be able to click on a project to view detailed progress reports and milestones.

User Stories.Title: Initiate New Proposal
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to initiate a new proposal so that I can start a new project with the company.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'New Proposal' section, then I should be able to fill out a form with my project requirements.
Upon submission, the system should generate a lead and notify me that my proposal has been received.
I should receive a confirmation email with the details of my proposal.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot for Quick Answers
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to use a chatbot to get quick answers about my projects and contracts so that I can resolve my queries efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'Chatbot' section, then I should be able to ask questions about my contracts and projects.
The chatbot should provide accurate and relevant answers based on the data available in the system.
If the chatbot cannot answer a question, it should provide an option to escalate the query to a human representative.

User Stories.Title: Download Contract Documents
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to download my contract documents so that I can keep a local copy for my records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a contract in the client portal, when I click the 'Download' button, then the contract document should be downloaded in PDF format.
The downloaded document should contain all the details of the contract as displayed in the portal.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive notifications about important updates to my projects and contracts so that I am always informed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when there is an important update to my project or contract, then I should receive a notification within the portal.
I should also receive an email notification with the details of the update.

Clients.Title: Client Chatbot Integration
Clients.Description: Integrate a chatbot within the client portal powered by OpenAI API. The chatbot will be trained on client-relevant data, including client emails and progress reports, to provide quick answers and support for client inquiries.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Initial Setup
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want the chatbot to be available in the client portal so that I can access it for quick support and inquiries.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot is accessible from the client portal interface.
The chatbot interface is user-friendly and easy to navigate.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Training on Client Emails
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want the chatbot to be trained on my email communications with the company so that it can provide accurate and relevant responses based on my past interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot is trained on all past email communications between the client and the company.
The chatbot can accurately reference and summarize past email conversations.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Training on Progress Reports
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want the chatbot to be trained on my project progress reports so that it can provide updates and details about my ongoing projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot is trained on all progress reports related to the client's projects.
The chatbot can provide detailed updates and summaries of project progress.

User Stories.Title: Quick Answers on Project Status
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want the chatbot to provide quick answers regarding the status of my projects so that I can get updates without waiting for a human response.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot can answer questions about the current status of the client's projects.
The chatbot provides accurate and up-to-date information.

User Stories.Title: Initiate New Proposals via Chatbot
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to be able to initiate new project proposals through the chatbot so that I can quickly start new projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot can guide the client through the process of initiating a new proposal.
The chatbot collects all necessary information for the new proposal and submits it to the system.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Response to Common Inquiries
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want the chatbot to answer common inquiries about contracts, billing, and other administrative matters so that I can resolve issues quickly.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot can answer frequently asked questions about contracts, billing, and administrative matters.
The chatbot provides accurate and helpful responses to these inquiries.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Feedback Mechanism
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to provide feedback on the chatbot's responses so that the system can improve over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot includes a mechanism for clients to provide feedback on its responses.
Client feedback is collected and used to improve the chatbot's performance.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Security and Privacy
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to ensure that my interactions with the chatbot are secure and private so that my sensitive information is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot interactions are encrypted and secure.
Client data used by the chatbot is handled in compliance with data protection regulations.

Clients.Title: Proposal Initiation and Tracking
Clients.Description: Enable clients to initiate new proposals through the client portal using the Myte Estimates tool. This feature will allow clients to input their requirements, which will then be evaluated and tracked as leads and proposals by the company.

User Stories.Title: Client Proposal Initiation
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to initiate a new proposal through the client portal so that I can easily communicate my project requirements to the company.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the proposal initiation section, I should see an option to start a new proposal.
When I click on the 'Start New Proposal' button, I should be presented with a form to input my project requirements.
The form should include fields for project title, description, requirements, estimated budget, and timeline.
When I submit the form, I should receive a confirmation message that my proposal has been successfully submitted.

User Stories.Title: Proposal Form Validation
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want the proposal form to validate my input so that I can ensure all required information is provided before submission.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am filling out the proposal form, when I leave a required field empty and try to submit, I should see an error message indicating the missing information.
The form should validate the format of the email address and phone number fields.
The form should not allow submission if any required fields are missing or incorrectly formatted.

User Stories.Title: Proposal Submission Confirmation
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive a confirmation email after submitting a proposal so that I have a record of my submission.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have successfully submitted a proposal, when the submission is processed, I should receive a confirmation email with the details of my proposal.
The email should include the proposal ID, project title, description, and the date of submission.

User Stories.Title: View Submitted Proposals
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view a list of my submitted proposals so that I can track their status and review their details.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'My Proposals' section, I should see a list of all proposals I have submitted.
Each proposal entry should display the proposal ID, project title, submission date, and current status.
When I click on a proposal entry, I should be able to view the full details of that proposal.

User Stories.Title: Proposal Status Updates
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive status updates on my proposals so that I am informed about their progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have submitted a proposal, when the status of my proposal changes, I should receive an email notification with the updated status.
The client portal should also display the current status of each proposal in the 'My Proposals' section.

User Stories.Title: Edit Proposal
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to be able to edit my submitted proposal before it is evaluated so that I can make any necessary changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have submitted a proposal, when I navigate to the 'My Proposals' section and select a proposal that is not yet evaluated, I should see an option to edit the proposal.
When I click on the 'Edit Proposal' button, I should be able to modify the proposal details and save the changes.
After saving the changes, the updated proposal should be reflected in the 'My Proposals' section.

User Stories.Title: Proposal Evaluation Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive feedback on my proposal after it has been evaluated so that I know the company's decision and any next steps.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given my proposal has been evaluated, when the evaluation is complete, I should receive an email with the feedback and any next steps.
The feedback should also be available in the 'My Proposals' section of the client portal.

Clients.Title: Contract Management and Digital Signatures
Clients.Description: Implement a system for creating, sending, and storing contracts digitally. Clients will be able to review and sign contracts electronically, ensuring a seamless and efficient contract management process.

User Stories.Title: Create Contract
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive a contract template so that I can review the terms and conditions before signing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is ready, when the client is notified, then the client should receive a link to view the contract template.
The contract template should be accessible via a secure link.
The client should be able to view all sections of the contract clearly.

User Stories.Title: Review Contract
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to review the contract details so that I can ensure all terms and conditions are acceptable.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is available, when the client accesses the link, then the client should be able to review the entire contract.
The client should be able to navigate through different sections of the contract easily.
The client should be able to download a copy of the contract for offline review.

User Stories.Title: Sign Contract Electronically
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to sign the contract electronically so that I can complete the agreement process quickly and efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is reviewed, when the client agrees to the terms, then the client should be able to sign the contract electronically.
The electronic signature should be legally binding and secure.
The client should receive a confirmation after signing the contract.

User Stories.Title: Store Signed Contract
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want my signed contract to be stored digitally so that I can access it anytime in the future.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is signed, when the client completes the signing process, then the contract should be stored digitally in a secure location.
The client should be able to access the signed contract through their client portal.
The stored contract should be protected against unauthorized access.

User Stories.Title: Receive Contract Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive notifications about contract status updates so that I am informed about important changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract status changes, when the client is subscribed to notifications, then the client should receive an email or in-app notification.
The notification should include details about the status change and any required actions from the client.
The client should be able to manage their notification preferences through the client portal.

User Stories.Title: Track Contract History
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view the history of all communications related to my contract so that I can keep track of all interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is active, when the client accesses the contract history, then the client should see a list of all emails and communications related to the contract.
Each communication entry should include the date, sender/receiver, and content summary.
The client should be able to filter and search through the communication history.

User Stories.Title: Download Signed Contract
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to download a copy of my signed contract so that I can keep a local copy for my records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is signed, when the client accesses the contract in the client portal, then the client should see an option to download the signed contract.
The downloaded contract should be in a commonly used format (e.g., PDF).
The downloaded contract should include all signatures and be identical to the stored version.

User Stories.Title: Initiate Contract Review
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to request a review of my contract so that I can discuss any changes or concerns with the service provider.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is available, when the client requests a review, then the service provider should be notified of the client's request.
The client should be able to provide comments or questions along with the review request.
The client should receive a confirmation that their review request has been submitted.

Clients.Title: Progress Report Notifications
Clients.Description: Provide clients with regular updates on project progress through automated notifications. These updates will include detailed reports generated by the Myte Code Checker, ensuring clients are always informed about the status of their projects.

User Stories.Title: Daily Progress Report Generation
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive daily progress reports generated by the Myte Code Checker so that I can stay informed about the latest updates on my project's status.
AcceptanceCriteria: A daily report is generated by the Myte Code Checker.
The report includes a summary of code changes and progress updates.
The report is formatted in natural language for easy understanding.

User Stories.Title: Automated Email Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive automated email notifications with the daily progress report so that I am always up-to-date without needing to manually check for updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: An email is automatically sent to the client's registered email address daily.
The email contains the progress report generated by the Myte Code Checker.
The email is sent at a consistent time each day.

User Stories.Title: Customizable Notification Preferences
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to customize my notification preferences so that I can choose how frequently I receive updates about my project's progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can choose the frequency of notifications (e.g., daily, weekly, bi-weekly).
Clients can update their preferences through the client portal.
The system respects the updated preferences and sends notifications accordingly.

User Stories.Title: Access to Historical Reports
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to access historical progress reports through the client portal so that I can review past updates and track the project's progress over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can view a list of all past progress reports in the client portal.
Reports are organized by date and can be easily accessed.
Clients can download or print the reports for their records.

User Stories.Title: Real-time Progress Updates
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive real-time progress updates through the client portal so that I can check the status of my project at any time.
AcceptanceCriteria: The client portal displays real-time updates on project progress.
Clients can see the latest code changes and progress metrics.
The information is refreshed regularly to ensure it is up-to-date.

User Stories.Title: Progress Report Summary
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want a summary section in the progress report so that I can quickly understand the key updates without reading through the entire report.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each progress report includes a summary section at the top.
The summary highlights the most important updates and changes.
Clients can expand the summary to view more detailed information if needed.

User Stories.Title: Notification Delivery Confirmation
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive a confirmation that my progress report notification has been delivered so that I know the update has been sent successfully.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients receive a delivery confirmation email or notification.
The confirmation includes the date and time the progress report was sent.
If the notification fails to deliver, the system alerts the client and retries sending.

User Stories.Title: Feedback on Progress Reports
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to provide feedback on the progress reports so that the development team can improve the quality and relevance of the updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can submit feedback through the client portal.
The feedback form allows clients to rate the report and provide comments.
The development team receives and reviews the feedback for continuous improvement.

Clients.Title: Communication History Access
Clients.Description: Maintain a comprehensive history of all communications related to each contract within the client portal. Clients will be able to access past emails and messages, ensuring all interactions are well-documented and easily retrievable.

User Stories.Title: View Past Emails
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view all past emails related to my contract so that I can easily access and review previous communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to my contract, then I should see a list of all past emails related to that contract.
Each email entry should display the date received/sent and the content of the email.
Emails should be sorted in chronological order by default.

User Stories.Title: Search Email History
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to search through my email history by keywords so that I can quickly find specific communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the email history for a contract, when I enter a keyword in the search bar, then I should see a list of emails containing that keyword.
The search results should highlight the keyword within the email content.

User Stories.Title: Filter Emails by Date Range
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to filter my email history by date range so that I can focus on communications within a specific period.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the email history for a contract, when I select a start and end date, then I should see only the emails sent/received within that date range.
The date filter should be easily adjustable and resettable.

User Stories.Title: Download Email History
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to download the entire email history related to my contract so that I can keep a local copy for my records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the email history for a contract, when I click the 'Download' button, then I should be able to download a file containing all the emails.
The downloaded file should be in a readable format (e.g., PDF or CSV).

User Stories.Title: View Sent Emails
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view all emails sent by the company related to my contract so that I can see the responses and actions taken.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to my contract, then I should see a list of all emails sent by the company related to that contract.
Each email entry should display the date sent and the content of the email.

User Stories.Title: View Received Emails
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view all emails I have sent to the company related to my contract so that I can see my previous queries and communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to my contract, then I should see a list of all emails I have sent to the company related to that contract.
Each email entry should display the date received by the company and the content of the email.

User Stories.Title: Email Thread View
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view email threads in a conversation format so that I can follow the flow of communication more easily.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the email history for a contract, when I select an email, then I should see the entire thread of related emails in a conversation format.
The thread should display emails in chronological order, showing both sent and received emails.

User Stories.Title: Email Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive notifications for new emails related to my contract so that I am always up-to-date with the latest communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when a new email is received related to my contract, then I should receive a notification within the portal.
The notification should include a brief summary of the email and a link to view the full content.

User Stories.Title: Email Attachment Access
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to access attachments from past emails so that I can review any documents or files sent during our communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the email history for a contract, when I select an email with an attachment, then I should see a link or button to download the attachment.
The attachment should be downloadable in its original format.

User Stories.Title: Email Export
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to export selected emails to my personal email account so that I can forward important communications to my team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the email history for a contract, when I select one or more emails, then I should see an option to export these emails to my personal email account.
The exported emails should retain their original content and formatting.

Clients.Title: Invoice and Payment Tracking
Clients.Description: Develop a system for clients to view and track their invoices and payments. This feature will provide a clear overview of all financial transactions related to their contracts, ensuring transparency and ease of financial management.

User Stories.Title: View Invoices
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view a list of all my invoices so that I can see the details of each financial transaction related to my contracts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'Invoices' section, then I should see a list of all my invoices.
Each invoice should display the invoice number, date issued, due date, amount, and status (e.g., paid, unpaid, overdue).

User Stories.Title: View Invoice Details
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view the details of a specific invoice so that I can understand the breakdown of charges and services provided.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the list of invoices, when I click on an invoice, then I should see the detailed view of that invoice.
The detailed view should include itemized charges, descriptions of services, hours worked, rates, and total amount.

User Stories.Title: Download Invoice
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to download an invoice as a PDF so that I can keep a record of it for my own documentation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the details of an invoice, when I click the 'Download' button, then the invoice should be downloaded as a PDF file.

User Stories.Title: Track Payment Status
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to track the payment status of my invoices so that I can know which invoices are paid, unpaid, or overdue.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the list of invoices, each invoice should display its payment status (paid, unpaid, overdue).
The payment status should be updated in real-time based on the latest payment information.

User Stories.Title: Make a Payment
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to make a payment for an unpaid invoice directly through the client portal so that I can settle my dues conveniently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the details of an unpaid invoice, when I click the 'Pay Now' button, then I should be directed to a secure payment gateway.
After completing the payment, the invoice status should update to 'Paid' and a confirmation message should be displayed.

User Stories.Title: View Payment History
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view my payment history so that I can keep track of all payments I have made for my invoices.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the client portal, when I navigate to the 'Payment History' section, then I should see a list of all payments made.
Each payment entry should display the payment date, amount, and the invoice it was applied to.

User Stories.Title: Receive Payment Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive notifications about my invoice payments so that I am aware of due dates and payment confirmations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have an unpaid invoice, when the due date is approaching, then I should receive a notification reminding me to make a payment.
After making a payment, I should receive a confirmation notification indicating that the payment was successful.

User Stories.Title: Filter and Search Invoices
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to filter and search my invoices so that I can easily find specific invoices based on criteria such as date range, status, or amount.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the list of invoices, when I use the filter options, then the list should update to show only the invoices that match the selected criteria.
When I use the search bar, the list should update in real-time to show invoices that match the search term.

User Stories.Title: Export Invoices and Payments
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to export my invoices and payment history to a CSV file so that I can analyze my financial data offline.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the list of invoices or payment history, when I click the 'Export' button, then a CSV file containing the relevant data should be downloaded.

User Stories.Title: View Overdue Invoices
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view a list of overdue invoices so that I can prioritize making payments for those invoices.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the list of invoices, when I apply the 'Overdue' filter, then I should see only the invoices that are past their due date.

Clients.Title: Client Feedback and Support
