Clients.Description: Implement a feedback and support system within the client portal. Clients will be able to provide feedback on the services received and request support for any issues or inquiries, ensuring continuous improvement and client satisfaction.

User Stories.Title: Submit Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to submit feedback on the services received so that the company can improve their offerings and address any concerns I have.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can access a feedback form within the client portal.
The feedback form includes fields for rating services, providing comments, and selecting service categories.
Clients can submit the feedback form, and a confirmation message is displayed upon successful submission.
Submitted feedback is stored in the system and linked to the client's account.

User Stories.Title: Request Support
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to request support for any issues or inquiries so that I can get assistance promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can access a support request form within the client portal.
The support request form includes fields for describing the issue, selecting the urgency level, and attaching relevant files.
Clients can submit the support request form, and a confirmation message is displayed upon successful submission.
Submitted support requests are stored in the system and linked to the client's account.

User Stories.Title: View Feedback History
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view my past feedback submissions so that I can track the status and responses to my feedback.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can access a feedback history section within the client portal.
The feedback history section displays a list of all feedback submissions with details such as date, service category, and status.
Clients can click on a feedback entry to view detailed information and any responses from the company.

User Stories.Title: View Support Request History
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view my past support requests so that I can track the status and responses to my inquiries.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can access a support request history section within the client portal.
The support request history section displays a list of all support requests with details such as date, issue description, urgency level, and status.
Clients can click on a support request entry to view detailed information and any responses from the company.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Feedback and Support
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive notifications for updates on my feedback and support requests so that I am informed about the progress and responses.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients receive email notifications for any updates or responses to their feedback submissions.
Clients receive email notifications for any updates or responses to their support requests.
Notifications include relevant details such as the status update and any actions taken by the company.

User Stories.Title: Provide Feedback Anonymously
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want the option to provide feedback anonymously so that I can share my honest opinions without revealing my identity.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can choose to submit feedback anonymously by selecting an option on the feedback form.
Anonymous feedback submissions do not include any identifiable client information.
Anonymous feedback is stored in the system and can be reviewed by the company without linking to a specific client account.

User Stories.Title: Chat with Support Representative
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to chat with a support representative in real-time so that I can get immediate assistance for urgent issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can access a live chat feature within the client portal.
The live chat feature connects clients with available support representatives.
Clients can send and receive messages in real-time, and the chat history is saved for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Rate Support Experience
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to rate my support experience after resolving an issue so that the company can evaluate and improve their support services.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients are prompted to rate their support experience after a support request is marked as resolved.
The rating form includes fields for rating the support experience and providing additional comments.
Clients can submit the rating form, and the feedback is stored in the system for analysis.

Company Management.Title: Comprehensive CRM System
Company Management.Description: Develop a CRM system to manage company, office, and contact information, including automated email extraction and analysis to maintain a comprehensive conversation history.

User Stories.Title: Email Extraction and Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to extract and analyze all received emails from Gmail using OpenAI GPT-4o so that I can populate the CRM with contact details and maintain a comprehensive conversation history.
AcceptanceCriteria: Extract all received emails from Gmail.
Analyze emails using OpenAI GPT-4o to extract details like Name, Company Name, Address, and Phone Number.
Store extracted details in the CRM.
Maintain a conversation history for each contact, including Date Received and Content of the Email.

User Stories.Title: Sent Email Collection
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to collect all sent emails and associate them with the relevant contact in the CRM so that I can maintain a comprehensive conversation history.
AcceptanceCriteria: Collect all sent emails from Gmail.
Associate each sent email with the relevant contact in the CRM.
Store the sent emails with Date Sent and Content of the Email.

User Stories.Title: Continuous Email Syncing
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to ensure continuous syncing of emails so that contact information in the CRM is always up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Implement a process to continuously sync received and sent emails.
Ensure that any new emails are analyzed and added to the CRM promptly.
Verify that contact details and conversation histories are updated in real-time.

User Stories.Title: New Lead Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to track new opportunities associated with an account so that I can monitor their status until they become a proposal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Allow creation of new leads associated with an account.
Track the status of each lead from initiation to proposal.
Display the lead status in the CRM dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Proposal Preparation
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to prepare project breakdowns and proposals using Myte Estimates so that I can provide detailed and accurate proposals to clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integrate Myte Estimates with the CRM.
Allow input of client requirements into Myte Estimates.
Generate a PDF proposal with requirements, epics, stories, tasks, estimated time, cost, and risks.
Store the generated proposals in the CRM.

User Stories.Title: Send Proposal
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to send prepared proposals to clients via email so that they can review and approve the proposals.
AcceptanceCriteria: Select a prepared proposal from the CRM.
Send the proposal as a PDF attachment to the client's email.
Track the sent proposal in the CRM with Date Sent and Content.

User Stories.Title: Contract Creation and Management
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to create, send, and store contracts digitally so that I can manage client agreements efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Generate contract templates for client review and signature.
Send contracts to clients for digital signatures.
Store signed contracts in the CRM.
Link contracts to the responsible employee and relevant account.

User Stories.Title: Contract Email History
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to maintain a history of all emails associated with each contract so that I can track all communications related to the contract.
AcceptanceCriteria: Track all received emails related to a contract with Sender, Date Received, and Content.
Track all sent emails related to a contract with Employee Name, Date Sent, and Content.
Store the email history in the contract record in the CRM.

User Stories.Title: CRM Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want a dashboard to view CRM data, opportunities, leads, proposals, contracts, and communication history so that I can manage and monitor all business interactions efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Display CRM data including company, office, and contact information.
Show opportunities and their statuses.
List leads and their progress.
Display proposals and their statuses.
Show contracts and their email histories.
Provide a comprehensive view of all communications with contacts.

Company Management.Title: Lead and Opportunity Tracking
Company Management.Description: Implement a system to track new leads and opportunities, monitoring their status until they become proposals, ensuring a streamlined sales process.

User Stories.Title: Create New Lead
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to create a new lead in the system so that I can start tracking potential business opportunities from the initial stage.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the 'Leads' section, I should see an option to create a new lead.
When I click on 'Create New Lead', a form should appear to input details such as Lead Name, Company Name, Contact Information, and Initial Notes.
When I submit the form, the new lead should be saved in the system and appear in the 'Leads' list.

User Stories.Title: Update Lead Status
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to update the status of a lead so that I can reflect the current stage of the sales process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a lead's details, I should see an option to update the lead's status.
The status options should include stages such as 'New', 'Contacted', 'Qualified', 'Proposal Sent', and 'Closed'.
When I select a new status and save the changes, the lead's status should be updated and reflected in the system.

User Stories.Title: View Lead Details
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view detailed information about a lead so that I can understand its history and current status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the 'Leads' list, when I click on a lead, I should be taken to a detailed view page.
The detailed view should include information such as Lead Name, Company Name, Contact Information, Status, and History of Interactions.

User Stories.Title: Track Lead Interactions
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to track all interactions with a lead so that I have a complete history of communications and actions taken.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a lead's details, I should see a section for 'Interaction History'.
When I add a new interaction (e.g., email, call, meeting), it should be saved and appear in the 'Interaction History' section.
Each interaction entry should include the date, type of interaction, and a brief summary.

User Stories.Title: Convert Lead to Opportunity
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to convert a lead to an opportunity so that I can start tracking it as a potential proposal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a lead's details, I should see an option to 'Convert to Opportunity'.
When I click 'Convert to Opportunity', the lead should be moved to the 'Opportunities' section with all its details intact.
The system should prompt me to confirm the conversion and allow me to add any additional information required for the opportunity.

User Stories.Title: View Opportunity Pipeline
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view the opportunity pipeline so that I can see all opportunities and their current statuses in one place.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when I navigate to the 'Opportunities' section, I should see a list of all opportunities.
Each opportunity should display key information such as Opportunity Name, Company Name, Contact Information, Status, and Expected Close Date.
I should be able to filter and sort the opportunities based on different criteria such as status, date, and company.

User Stories.Title: Generate Opportunity Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to generate reports on opportunities so that I can analyze the sales pipeline and make informed decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in the 'Opportunities' section, I should see an option to generate reports.
When I select the report type (e.g., status report, win/loss analysis), the system should generate a report based on the selected criteria.
The report should be downloadable in formats such as PDF and Excel.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications for Lead Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to receive notifications for updates on leads so that I am always informed about the latest changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the system, when a lead's status is updated, I should receive a notification.
Notifications should be visible in a notification center within the system and optionally sent via email.
Each notification should include details about the lead and the specific update made.

Company Management.Title: Proposal and Contract Management
Company Management.Description: Create tools for generating detailed project breakdowns and proposals, sending proposals to clients, and managing digital contracts with a comprehensive contract database.

User Stories.Title: Generate Project Breakdown and Proposal
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to generate a detailed project breakdown and proposal using Myte Estimates so that I can provide clients with accurate and comprehensive project plans.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a set of client requirements, when I input them into Myte Estimates, then a PDF with all requirements, epics, stories, tasks, estimated time, cost, and risks should be generated.
The generated PDF should be stored in a database of prepared proposals.

User Stories.Title: Send Proposal to Client
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to send a prepared proposal to the client's email so that the client can review the project details and make informed decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of prepared proposals, when I select a proposal and choose to send it, then the PDF should be emailed to the client's email address.
The system should confirm that the email has been sent successfully.

User Stories.Title: Create and Send Contract for Signature
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to create and send a contract template for client review and signature so that we can formalize agreements digitally.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract template, when I generate a new contract, then the contract should be populated with relevant details and sent to the client for review and signature.
The signed contract should be stored digitally in the contract database.

User Stories.Title: Manage Contract Database
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to manage a comprehensive contract database so that all contracts are linked to relevant accounts and employees, and all communications are tracked.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new contract, when it is created, then it should be linked to the responsible employee and the relevant account.
All emails associated with each contract should be tracked, including sender, date received, and content for received emails, and employee name, date sent, and content for sent emails.

User Stories.Title: Track New Leads and Opportunities
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to track new leads and opportunities associated with an account so that I can monitor their status until they become proposals.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new lead, when it is added to the system, then it should be associated with the relevant account and tracked until it becomes a proposal.
The system should update the status of the opportunity as it progresses.

User Stories.Title: Sync Email Communications
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to sync all received and sent emails with the CRM so that contact information and conversation history are always up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new email received or sent, when it is processed, then the contact information and conversation history in the CRM should be updated automatically.
The system should maintain a continuous syncing process to ensure data is always current.

User Stories.Title: Prepare Invoice Based on Contract Activities
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to prepare invoices based on account/contact information and hours spent by activity so that I can bill clients accurately for services rendered.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a completed task, when the time spent is recorded, then the system should compile the hours and generate an invoice for the relevant contract.
The invoice should be linked to the accounting system for further processing.

User Stories.Title: Distribute Tasks to Coders
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to distribute tasks to international coders and track their time spent so that I can manage project progress and invoicing effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new project, when tasks are created, then they should be distributed to the assigned coders.
The system should track the start and end times of each task and compile the time spent for invoicing purposes.

User Stories.Title: Generate Daily Code Change Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to generate daily reports of code changes using Myte Code Checker so that clients are kept informed of project progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a code repository, when changes are made, then the system should compare the current state with the previous day's state and generate a natural language report.
The report should be automatically sent to the contract contact daily.

User Stories.Title: Manage Client Portal
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to provide clients with a portal where they can view their contracts, communications, and project progress so that they have easy access to important information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a client login, when they access the portal, then they should be able to view their contracts, communications, and project progress.
The portal should include a chatbot for quick answers and the ability to initiate new proposals.

Company Management.Title: Project Kick-Off and Task Management
Company Management.Description: Develop a system to distribute tasks to international coders, track task progress and time spent, and compile this data for invoicing and project management purposes.

User Stories.Title: Task Distribution to International Coders
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to distribute tasks to international coders so that I can ensure that work is allocated efficiently and coders know what they need to work on.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows the manager to create tasks and assign them to specific coders.
Tasks can include details such as description, priority, and due date.
Coders receive notifications when new tasks are assigned to them.

User Stories.Title: Track Task Start and End Times
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want coders to log the start and end times of their tasks so that I can monitor the time spent on each task.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can log the start and end times for each task.
The system records and stores the logged times for each task.
Managers can view the logged times in a report format.

User Stories.Title: Compile Time Spent for Invoicing
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to compile the time spent on tasks by each coder so that I can generate accurate invoices for clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system aggregates the time spent on tasks by each coder.
Managers can generate a report showing the total time spent per coder and per contract.
The compiled data can be exported for invoicing purposes.

User Stories.Title: Task Progress Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to track the progress of tasks so that I can ensure projects are on schedule.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders can update the status of their tasks (e.g., Not Started, In Progress, Completed).
Managers can view the current status of all tasks in a project overview.
The system provides notifications for overdue tasks.

User Stories.Title: Daily Task Summary Report
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to receive a daily summary report of task progress and time spent so that I can stay informed about the project's status.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system generates a daily summary report of all tasks, including status and time spent.
The report is automatically emailed to the manager at the end of each day.
The report includes a summary of completed tasks, tasks in progress, and any overdue tasks.

User Stories.Title: Task Assignment Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want coders to receive notifications when they are assigned new tasks so that they are immediately aware of their responsibilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders receive an email notification when a new task is assigned to them.
The notification includes details of the task such as description, priority, and due date.
Coders can acknowledge receipt of the task through the system.

User Stories.Title: Task Reassignment
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to reassign tasks to different coders if necessary so that I can manage workload and ensure tasks are completed on time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Managers can reassign tasks to different coders through the system.
The original coder and the new coder receive notifications about the reassignment.
The system updates the task history to reflect the reassignment.

User Stories.Title: Task Dependency Management
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to set dependencies between tasks so that coders know the order in which tasks need to be completed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Managers can set dependencies between tasks (e.g., Task B cannot start until Task A is completed).
The system enforces task dependencies and prevents coders from starting dependent tasks prematurely.
Coders are notified of task dependencies and the status of prerequisite tasks.

User Stories.Title: Task Prioritization
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to prioritize tasks so that coders know which tasks are most important and should be completed first.
AcceptanceCriteria: Managers can assign priority levels to tasks (e.g., High, Medium, Low).
Coders can view the priority level of each task in their task list.
The system sorts tasks by priority in the coders' task lists.

User Stories.Title: Historical Task Data
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to access historical data on completed tasks so that I can review past project performance and make informed decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system stores historical data on all completed tasks, including time spent and task status.
Managers can search and filter historical task data by date range, coder, and project.
Historical task data can be exported for further analysis.

Company Management.Title: Automated Code Analysis and Reporting
Company Management.Description: Implement the Myte Code Checker tool to analyze daily code changes, generate natural language reports, and send updates to clients automatically.

User Stories.Title: Daily Code Repository Comparison
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to compare the current day's code repository with the previous day's repository so that I can track code changes accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should fetch the current day's code repository data.
The tool should fetch the previous day's code repository data.
The tool should compare the two sets of data and identify changes.
The tool should log the identified changes for further analysis.

User Stories.Title: Natural Language Report Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to generate a natural language report of the code changes so that the updates are easily understandable.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should use OpenAI Transformers to analyze the identified code changes.
The tool should generate a natural language report summarizing the changes.
The report should include details like the files changed, lines of code added/removed, and a summary of the changes.

User Stories.Title: Automated Report Delivery
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to automatically send the generated report to the contract contact daily so that clients are kept up-to-date without manual intervention.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should have a configurable schedule for sending reports.
The tool should automatically send the generated report to the client's email address.
The tool should log the successful delivery of the report.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling and Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to handle errors gracefully and notify me of any issues so that I can ensure the tool is functioning correctly.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should log any errors encountered during the comparison or report generation process.
The tool should send an email notification to the Company Manager in case of errors.
The notification should include details about the error and potential steps to resolve it.

User Stories.Title: Customizable Report Content
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to customize the content of the generated reports so that they meet specific client requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should allow customization of report content through a user-friendly interface.
The customization options should include selecting specific types of changes to include, formatting options, and additional commentary sections.
The tool should save and apply these customizations for future reports.

User Stories.Title: Historical Report Access
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to access historical reports generated by the Myte Code Checker so that I can review past code changes and client communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should store all generated reports in a secure database.
The tool should provide a user interface to search and retrieve historical reports.
The retrieved reports should be viewable and downloadable in their original format.

User Stories.Title: Client-Specific Report Customization
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to customize reports for specific clients so that each client receives tailored updates according to their preferences.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should allow setting client-specific report preferences.
The preferences should include options for report frequency, content, and delivery method.
The tool should apply these preferences when generating and sending reports to the respective clients.

User Stories.Title: Integration with Project Management System
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to integrate with the existing project management system so that code changes are linked to specific tasks and projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should fetch task and project information from the project management system.
The tool should link identified code changes to the relevant tasks and projects.
The tool should include this linkage information in the generated reports.

Company Management.Title: Invoicing and Accounting Integration
Company Management.Description: Create an invoicing system linked to the accounting module, integrating with the TD API to monitor financial transactions and prepare documentation for CPAs.

User Stories.Title: Generate Invoice Based on Hours Worked
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to generate invoices based on hours worked by employees on different contracts so that I can bill clients accurately for the services provided.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the hours worked by employees on a contract, when I generate an invoice, then the invoice should include the total hours worked, hourly rate, and total amount due.
Given a contract, when I generate an invoice, then the invoice should include the client's contact information and contract details.

User Stories.Title: Integrate Invoicing System with Accounting Module
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want the invoicing system to be integrated with the accounting module so that all financial transactions are recorded and managed efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invoice is generated, when it is finalized, then the details should be automatically recorded in the accounting module.
Given a finalized invoice, when I view the accounting module, then I should see the invoice details including the amount due and payment status.

User Stories.Title: Monitor Financial Transactions via TD API
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to monitor financial transactions via the TD API so that I can keep track of all business credit card and checking account transactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the TD API is connected, when a transaction occurs, then it should be recorded in the accounting module with details such as date, amount, and transaction type.
Given the accounting module, when I view the financial transactions, then I should see all transactions pulled from the TD API in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Prepare Documentation for CPA
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to prepare documentation for the CPA so that all financial records are organized and ready for official review and submission to the government.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the financial records, when I prepare documentation, then it should include all necessary details such as income, expenses, and transaction history.
Given the prepared documentation, when I review it, then it should be formatted according to CPA requirements and include all relevant financial data.

User Stories.Title: Automate Invoice Generation Process
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to automate the invoice generation process so that it reduces manual effort and ensures timely billing.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a completed project or task, when the time tracking data is available, then the system should automatically generate an invoice based on the recorded hours and rates.
Given the automated invoice, when it is generated, then it should be reviewed for accuracy before being sent to the client.

User Stories.Title: Track Payment Status of Invoices
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to track the payment status of invoices so that I can follow up on unpaid invoices and manage cash flow effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invoice is sent, when the client makes a payment, then the payment status should be updated in the accounting module.
Given the accounting module, when I view an invoice, then I should see the current payment status (e.g., paid, unpaid, overdue).

User Stories.Title: Generate Financial Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to generate financial reports so that I can analyze the company's financial performance and make informed business decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the financial data, when I generate a report, then it should include key metrics such as total revenue, expenses, profit, and outstanding invoices.
Given the generated report, when I review it, then it should be presented in a clear and understandable format with visual aids like charts and graphs.

Company Management.Title: Employee Database and Management
Company Management.Description: Develop a comprehensive digital profile system for employees, enabling efficient management and tracking of employee information and tasks.

User Stories.Title: Create Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to create a digital profile for each employee so that I can store and manage all relevant employee information in one place.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new employee, when I enter their details, then a digital profile should be created and stored in the system.
The profile should include fields for name, contact information, job title, department, start date, and other relevant details.

User Stories.Title: Update Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to update an employee's profile so that I can keep their information current and accurate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an existing employee, when I update their details, then the changes should be saved and reflected in their profile.
The system should allow updates to all fields in the employee profile.

User Stories.Title: View Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view an employee's profile so that I can quickly access their information when needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an employee, when I select their profile, then I should be able to view all their stored information.
The profile view should be organized and easy to navigate.

User Stories.Title: Track Employee Tasks
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to track the tasks assigned to each employee so that I can monitor their workload and progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an employee, when I view their profile, then I should see a list of tasks assigned to them.
Each task should display its status, start date, end date, and any relevant notes.

User Stories.Title: Assign Tasks to Employees
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to assign tasks to employees so that I can delegate work efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a task, when I assign it to an employee, then it should appear in their profile under the task list.
The system should allow setting deadlines and priorities for each task.

User Stories.Title: Generate Employee Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to generate reports on employee performance and task completion so that I can evaluate their productivity.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an employee, when I request a report, then the system should generate a summary of their completed tasks, ongoing tasks, and performance metrics.
The report should be exportable in PDF format.

User Stories.Title: Search Employee Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to search for employee profiles by name or department so that I can quickly find the information I need.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a search query, when I enter it into the search bar, then the system should display a list of matching employee profiles.
The search results should be accurate and relevant to the query.

User Stories.Title: Set Employee Permissions
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to set permissions for each employee so that they have access only to the information and tools they need.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an employee, when I set their permissions, then the system should restrict or grant access to specific features based on their role.
The permissions should be customizable and role-based.

User Stories.Title: Archive Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to archive an employee's profile when they leave the company so that their information is retained but not active.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an employee who has left the company, when I archive their profile, then it should be moved to an archive section and no longer appear in active searches.
Archived profiles should be retrievable if needed.

User Stories.Title: Notify Employees of Task Assignments
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to notify employees when they are assigned new tasks so that they are aware of their responsibilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new task assignment, when I assign it to an employee, then the system should send a notification to the employee.
The notification should include task details and deadlines.

Company Management.Title: Myte Dashboard
Company Management.Description: Build a dashboard for company management to view CRM data, opportunities, contracts, RFIs, invoices, and other key metrics, including a chatbot for querying company data.

User Stories.Title: View CRM Data
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view CRM data on the dashboard so that I can monitor and manage company, office, and contact information efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: CRM data is displayed in an organized and accessible manner.
The dashboard shows company, office, and contact information.
Users can search and filter CRM data based on various criteria.

User Stories.Title: View Opportunities
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view opportunities on the dashboard so that I can track the status of new leads and potential business deals.
AcceptanceCriteria: Opportunities are displayed with their current status.
Users can filter opportunities by account, status, and date.
Opportunity details include relevant contact information and history.

User Stories.Title: View Contracts
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view contracts on the dashboard so that I can oversee active and historical contracts with clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contracts are displayed with their status (active, pending, completed).
Users can filter contracts by client, date, and status.
Contract details include linked emails and employee assignments.

User Stories.Title: View RFIs
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view RFIs on the dashboard so that I can monitor active and historical requests for information.
AcceptanceCriteria: RFIs are displayed with their status (active, pending, completed).
Users can filter RFIs by client, date, and status.
RFI details include linked emails and relevant project information.

User Stories.Title: View Invoices
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to view invoices on the dashboard so that I can track financial transactions and ensure timely payments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Invoices are displayed with their status (active, paid, overdue).
Users can filter invoices by client, date, and status.
Invoice details include linked contracts and payment history.

User Stories.Title: Query Company Data via Chatbot
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to use a chatbot to query company data so that I can quickly get answers to specific questions about CRM, opportunities, contracts, RFIs, and invoices.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chatbot can answer questions about CRM data, opportunities, contracts, RFIs, and invoices.
The chatbot provides accurate and relevant information based on the company's data.
Users can interact with the chatbot using natural language queries.

User Stories.Title: Dashboard Customization
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to customize the dashboard layout so that I can prioritize the information that is most important to me.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can rearrange and resize dashboard widgets.
Users can choose which data widgets to display on the dashboard.
Customizations are saved and persist across sessions.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Data Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want the dashboard to display real-time data updates so that I can make informed decisions based on the latest information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard automatically refreshes data at regular intervals.
Users can manually refresh data if needed.
Real-time updates are indicated with a timestamp.

User Stories.Title: Data Export
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to export dashboard data so that I can share reports and insights with other stakeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can export data in various formats (e.g., CSV, PDF).
Exported data includes all relevant details and filters applied.
Users can choose specific data widgets to export.

User Stories.Title: Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a Company Manager, I want to manage access control for the dashboard so that only authorized personnel can view or modify sensitive information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can set role-based access permissions for the dashboard.
Access control settings are easy to configure and manage.
Unauthorized users are restricted from accessing or modifying sensitive data.

Company Management.Title: Client Portal
Company Management.Description: Develop a client portal for clients to view their contracts, communications, and project progress, interact with a chatbot, and initiate new proposals.

User Stories.Title: Client Portal Access
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to access the client portal so that I can view my contracts, communications, and project progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can log in to the portal using secure credentials.
Clients can view a dashboard summarizing their contracts, communications, and project progress.

User Stories.Title: View Contracts
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view all my contracts so that I can keep track of my agreements with the company.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can see a list of all their contracts.
Clients can click on a contract to view its details, including start date, end date, and status.

User Stories.Title: View Communications
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view all communications related to my contracts so that I can stay informed about project updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can see a list of all communications related to each contract.
Clients can click on a communication to view its details, including date, sender, and content.

User Stories.Title: View Project Progress
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to view the progress of my projects so that I can monitor their status and milestones.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can see a progress bar or percentage completion for each project.
Clients can view detailed progress reports, including completed tasks and upcoming milestones.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Interaction
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to interact with a chatbot so that I can get quick answers to my questions about my projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can access the chatbot from the client portal.
The chatbot can answer questions about contract details, project progress, and communications.
The chatbot is powered by OpenAI API and trained on client-relevant data.

User Stories.Title: Initiate New Proposals
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to initiate new proposals so that I can start new projects with the company.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can fill out a form to specify their requirements for a new proposal.
The system generates a new proposal using Myte Estimates.
The new proposal is saved as a lead and can be evaluated by the company.

User Stories.Title: Secure Login
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to log in securely so that my data is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients must enter a username and password to access the portal.
The system uses HTTPS for secure data transmission.
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is available for added security.

User Stories.Title: Notification System
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to receive notifications about important updates so that I am always informed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients receive email notifications for important updates, such as new communications or project milestones.
Clients can configure their notification preferences in the portal.

User Stories.Title: User-Friendly Interface
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want a user-friendly interface so that I can easily navigate and use the portal.
AcceptanceCriteria: The portal has a clean and intuitive design.
Clients can easily find and access different sections, such as contracts, communications, and project progress.

User Stories.Title: Downloadable Reports
User Stories.Description: As a client, I want to download reports so that I can keep offline records of my project progress and communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can download project progress reports in PDF format.
Clients can download communication logs in PDF format.

Company Management.Title: Social Media and Content Management
Company Management.Description: Implement tools for automating social media outreach on Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook, and for creating and posting articles to various platforms.

User Stories.Title: Automate Twitter Outreach
User Stories.Description: As Company Management, I want to automate daily Twitter outreach so that I can stay informed about recent AI news and engage my audience consistently.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should research recent AI news daily.
The system should create a tweet thread based on the researched news.
The system should post the tweet thread to the company's Twitter account daily.

User Stories.Title: Automate LinkedIn Outreach
User Stories.Description: As Company Management, I want to automate LinkedIn outreach so that I can manage my LinkedIn CRM and send personalized messages to my contacts daily.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should analyze LinkedIn profiles in the CRM.
The system should craft personalized messages for each profile.
The system should send up to 30 personalized messages daily.

User Stories.Title: Automate Facebook Outreach
User Stories.Description: As Company Management, I want to automate Facebook outreach so that I can manage my Facebook CRM and send personalized messages to my contacts daily.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should analyze Facebook profiles in the CRM.
The system should craft personalized messages for each profile.
The system should send up to 30 personalized messages daily.

User Stories.Title: Automate Article Creation and Posting
User Stories.Description: As Company Management, I want to automate the creation and posting of articles so that I can maintain a consistent online presence and share valuable content with my audience.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should collect news on a given topic and timeframe from chosen sources.
The system should allow user input for additional thoughts.
The system should craft an article with embedded sources and a catchy title.
The system should post the article to LinkedIn, Twitter, and the company's personal website.

User Stories.Title: Human-like Social Media Operations
User Stories.Description: As Company Management, I want the system to operate in a human-like manner when posting articles and sending messages so that it avoids detection as automated behavior by social media platforms.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should mimic human interaction patterns when posting articles and sending messages.
The system should include random delays and varied interaction times to simulate human behavior.
The system should ensure compliance with social media platforms' terms of service.

User Stories.Title: Monitor and Report Social Media Engagement
User Stories.Description: As Company Management, I want to monitor and receive reports on social media engagement so that I can assess the effectiveness of the automated outreach and content posting.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should track engagement metrics such as likes, shares, comments, and followers.
The system should generate weekly reports summarizing social media engagement.
The system should provide insights and recommendations for improving engagement.

Project Managers.Title: CRM System Development
Project Managers.Description: Develop a comprehensive CRM system to manage company, office, and contact information. This includes extracting and analyzing emails using OpenAI GPT-4o to populate the CRM, maintaining a conversation history, and ensuring continuous syncing of contact information.

User Stories.Title: Email Extraction and Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to extract all received emails from Gmail and analyze them using OpenAI GPT-4o to populate the CRM with contact details so that I can have a comprehensive and up-to-date contact database.
AcceptanceCriteria: Extract all received emails from Gmail.
Use OpenAI GPT-4o to analyze email bodies and extract details like Name, Company Name, Address, and Phone Number.
Populate the CRM with extracted contact details.
Ensure the process is automated and runs periodically.

User Stories.Title: Sent Email Association
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to collect all sent emails and associate them with the corresponding contact in the CRM so that I can maintain a complete conversation history.
AcceptanceCriteria: Collect all sent emails from Gmail.
Associate each sent email with the corresponding contact in the CRM.
Store sent emails with the structure: Date Sent and Content of the Email.
Ensure the process is automated and runs periodically.

User Stories.Title: Conversation History Maintenance
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to maintain a conversation history for each contact so that I can easily review past communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Store all received emails with the structure: Date Received and Content of the Email.
Store all sent emails with the structure: Date Sent and Content of the Email.
Ensure the conversation history is easily accessible within the CRM.

User Stories.Title: Continuous Syncing of Contact Information
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to ensure continuous syncing of contact information with all received and sent emails so that the CRM is always up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Implement a syncing process that runs periodically to update contact information with new emails.
Ensure that any changes in contact details are reflected in the CRM.
Provide a notification system to alert when syncing is complete or if there are any errors.

User Stories.Title: New Lead Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to track new opportunities associated with an account so that I can monitor their status until they become a proposal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Create a system to log new leads associated with an account.
Track the status of each lead until it becomes a proposal.
Provide a dashboard to view all active leads and their statuses.

User Stories.Title: Proposal Preparation
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to prepare project breakdowns and proposals using Myte Estimates so that I can provide clients with detailed and accurate project plans.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integrate with Myte Estimates to input client requirements.
Generate a PDF with requirements, epics, stories, tasks, estimated time, cost, and risks.
Store the generated proposals in a database for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Send Proposal
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to send prepared proposals to clients via email so that I can streamline the proposal process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Select a prepared proposal from the database.
Send the proposal as a PDF attachment to the client's email.
Log the sent proposal in the CRM with the date and content of the email.

User Stories.Title: Contract Creation and Management
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to create and send contract templates for client review and signature so that I can manage contracts digitally.
AcceptanceCriteria: Generate contract templates for client review.
Send contracts to clients for digital signature.
Store signed contracts digitally in the CRM.
Link contracts to the responsible employee and maintain a history of all related emails.

User Stories.Title: Contract Email Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to track all emails associated with each contract so that I can maintain a comprehensive record of communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Track all received emails related to a contract with the structure: Sender, Date Received, and Content.
Track all sent emails related to a contract with the structure: Employee Name, Date Sent, and Content.
Ensure all emails are easily accessible within the contract's record in the CRM.

User Stories.Title: Dashboard for CRM Overview
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want a dashboard to view my CRM, opportunities, leads, proposals, contracts, and communications so that I can manage my tasks efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Provide a dashboard that displays CRM data, opportunities, leads, proposals, contracts, and communications.
Ensure the dashboard is user-friendly and provides real-time updates.
Include filtering and search functionalities to easily find specific information.

Project Managers.Title: Lead and Opportunity Tracking
Project Managers.Description: Implement a system to track new opportunities associated with accounts. This includes monitoring the status of opportunities until they become proposals, ensuring that PMs can manage and follow up on leads effectively.

User Stories.Title: Create New Opportunity
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to create a new opportunity associated with an account so that I can track potential business leads.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I navigate to the Opportunities section, I should see an option to create a new opportunity.
When I click on 'Create New Opportunity', I should be prompted to enter details such as Opportunity Name, Account Name, Contact Information, and Opportunity Description.
When I save the new opportunity, it should be associated with the specified account and visible in the Opportunities section.

User Stories.Title: Track Opportunity Status
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to update and track the status of an opportunity so that I can monitor its progress until it becomes a proposal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have created an opportunity, when I view the opportunity details, I should see a status field with options such as 'New', 'In Progress', 'Under Review', and 'Proposal Sent'.
When I change the status of an opportunity, the updated status should be saved and displayed in the opportunity details.
The system should log the status changes with timestamps for audit purposes.

User Stories.Title: View Opportunity Details
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view detailed information about an opportunity so that I can understand its current status and history.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the Opportunities section, when I click on an opportunity, I should be taken to a detailed view page.
The detailed view should display information such as Opportunity Name, Account Name, Contact Information, Opportunity Description, Status, and a history of status changes with timestamps.

User Stories.Title: Assign Opportunity to Team Member
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to assign an opportunity to a team member so that they can follow up and manage the lead.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing an opportunity, when I click on 'Assign to Team Member', I should see a list of available team members.
When I select a team member and confirm, the opportunity should be assigned to that team member and they should receive a notification.
The assigned team member's name should be displayed in the opportunity details.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications on Opportunity Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to receive notifications when there are updates to an opportunity so that I can stay informed about its progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am a Project Manager, when an opportunity I am managing is updated (e.g., status change, new comments), I should receive a notification.
Notifications should be visible in the notification center and optionally sent via email.
The notification should include details about the update and a link to the opportunity.

User Stories.Title: Generate Proposal from Opportunity
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to generate a proposal from an opportunity so that I can formalize the lead into a business proposal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing an opportunity, when I click on 'Generate Proposal', I should be prompted to confirm the action.
Upon confirmation, the system should use the opportunity details to generate a proposal document.
The generated proposal should be saved in the system and linked to the opportunity, and I should be able to download or send it via email.

User Stories.Title: Search and Filter Opportunities
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to search and filter opportunities so that I can quickly find specific leads based on criteria such as status, account name, or assigned team member.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the Opportunities section, when I use the search bar, I should be able to search for opportunities by keywords.
When I use the filter options, I should be able to filter opportunities by status, account name, assigned team member, and date range.
The search and filter results should be displayed in real-time, showing only the opportunities that match the criteria.

User Stories.Title: Export Opportunities Data
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to export opportunities data so that I can analyze it offline or share it with stakeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the Opportunities section, when I click on 'Export', I should be able to choose the format (e.g., CSV, Excel).
When I confirm the export, the system should generate a file with the selected format containing all the opportunities data.
The exported file should include all relevant details such as Opportunity Name, Account Name, Status, Assigned Team Member, and timestamps of status changes.

Project Managers.Title: Proposal Management
Project Managers.Description: Create a tool for preparing project breakdowns and proposals using Myte Estimates. This involves generating detailed PDFs with client requirements, estimated time, cost, and risks, and sending these proposals to clients.

User Stories.Title: Input Client Requirements
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to input client requirements into the Myte Estimates tool so that I can generate a detailed project breakdown.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows the PM to input client requirements through a user-friendly interface.
The input form includes fields for all necessary details such as project scope, objectives, and specific client needs.
The input data is saved and can be edited before final submission.

User Stories.Title: Generate Project Breakdown PDF
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to generate a PDF with project breakdown, including requirements, epics, stories, tasks, estimated time, cost, and risks, so that I can provide a comprehensive proposal to the client.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system uses the input client requirements to generate a detailed PDF.
The PDF includes sections for requirements, epics, stories, tasks, estimated time, cost, and risks.
The PDF is formatted professionally and is ready for client presentation.

User Stories.Title: Review and Edit Proposal
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to review and edit the generated proposal before sending it to the client so that I can ensure all details are accurate and complete.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system provides a preview of the generated PDF.
The PM can edit any part of the proposal before finalizing it.
Changes are saved and reflected in the final PDF.

User Stories.Title: Send Proposal to Client
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to send the finalized proposal PDF to the client's email so that they can review the project breakdown and make informed decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows the PM to select a finalized proposal from a list.
The PM can input the client's email address or select from the CRM.
The proposal is sent to the client's email with a confirmation notification to the PM.

User Stories.Title: Track Proposal Status
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to track the status of sent proposals so that I can follow up with clients and manage the proposal lifecycle.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system tracks the status of each sent proposal (e.g., sent, viewed, responded).
The PM can view the status of all proposals in a dashboard.
Notifications are sent to the PM for any updates or client responses.

User Stories.Title: Store Proposal History
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to store a history of all proposals sent to clients so that I can reference past proposals and maintain records.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system maintains a database of all sent proposals.
Each proposal entry includes the client details, proposal content, and status.
The PM can search and filter past proposals based on various criteria.

User Stories.Title: Automate Proposal Follow-Up
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to automate follow-up emails for sent proposals so that I can ensure timely client responses without manual effort.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows the PM to set follow-up schedules for sent proposals.
Automated follow-up emails are sent based on the set schedule.
The PM can customize the content of follow-up emails.

Project Managers.Title: Contract Management System
Project Managers.Description: Develop a system for creating, sending, and digitally storing contracts. This includes linking contracts to employees, maintaining a history of all related communications, and ensuring that all contractual obligations are well-documented and accessible.

User Stories.Title: Create Contract Template
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to create a contract template so that I can standardize the contracts sent to clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the contract management page, when I click on 'Create Template', then I should be able to input contract details and save the template.
The template should include placeholders for client-specific information such as name, company, and project details.
The saved template should be accessible for future use and editing.

User Stories.Title: Send Contract for Signature
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to send a contract to a client for digital signature so that the contract can be legally binding.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have selected a contract template, when I click on 'Send for Signature', then the contract should be sent to the client's email.
The client should receive an email with a link to digitally sign the contract.
Once the client signs the contract, I should receive a notification and the signed contract should be stored digitally.

User Stories.Title: Store Signed Contracts
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to store signed contracts digitally so that they are easily accessible and well-documented.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract has been signed, when the client submits the signed contract, then it should be automatically stored in the contract database.
The stored contract should include metadata such as the date of signature, client name, and project details.
I should be able to search and retrieve stored contracts using various filters (e.g., client name, date, project).

User Stories.Title: Link Contracts to Employees
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to link contracts to specific employees so that responsibilities are clearly assigned.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am creating or editing a contract, when I select an employee from the list, then the contract should be linked to that employee.
The linked employee should be notified of their responsibility for the contract.
I should be able to view all contracts linked to a specific employee from their profile.

User Stories.Title: Maintain Communication History
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to maintain a history of all communications related to a contract so that all interactions are well-documented.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is active, when I send or receive an email related to the contract, then the email should be automatically logged in the contract's communication history.
The communication history should include details such as sender, receiver, date, and content of the email.
I should be able to view the complete communication history for any contract from the contract details page.

User Stories.Title: Access Contractual Obligations
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to access all contractual obligations so that I can ensure compliance and track progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a contract is stored, when I view the contract details, then I should see a list of all contractual obligations.
Each obligation should include details such as due dates, responsible parties, and status.
I should be able to update the status of each obligation and add notes or comments.

User Stories.Title: Generate Contract Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to generate reports on contracts so that I can review and analyze contract performance and compliance.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the contract management page, when I click on 'Generate Report', then I should be able to select criteria such as date range, client, and status.
The generated report should include details such as contract status, communication history, and compliance with obligations.
I should be able to export the report in PDF or Excel format.

Project Managers.Title: Project Kick-Off and Task Management
Project Managers.Description: Implement a project kick-off system to distribute tasks to international coders, track task start and end times, and compile time spent per contract/coder for invoicing. This ensures efficient task management and accurate tracking of project progress.

User Stories.Title: Task Distribution to International Coders
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to distribute tasks to international coders so that they can start working on their assigned tasks efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a project plan, when I assign tasks, then the system should notify the respective coders with task details.
The system should allow me to set priorities and deadlines for each task.
Coders should receive notifications via email and within the system.

User Stories.Title: Track Task Start and End Times
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want coders to log their start and end times for each task so that I can monitor task progress and time spent accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: Coders should be able to log the start time when they begin a task.
Coders should be able to log the end time when they complete a task.
The system should automatically calculate the total time spent on each task.

User Stories.Title: Compile Time Spent Per Contract/Coder
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the system to compile the total time spent per contract and per coder so that I can generate accurate invoices.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should aggregate the time spent on tasks for each coder.
The system should aggregate the time spent on tasks for each contract.
The compiled time data should be exportable for invoicing purposes.

User Stories.Title: Generate Task Progress Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to generate progress reports based on task completion and time logs so that I can provide updates to clients and stakeholders.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should generate a report summarizing task completion status and time spent.
The report should be customizable to include specific details as needed.
The report should be exportable in PDF format.

User Stories.Title: Automated Notifications for Task Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the system to send automated notifications for task updates so that coders and stakeholders are informed in real-time.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should send notifications when a task is assigned, started, or completed.
Notifications should be sent via email and within the system.
The content of the notifications should include relevant task details and status updates.

User Stories.Title: Task Management Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want a dashboard to view and manage all tasks and their statuses so that I can have a clear overview of project progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard should display all tasks with their current status (e.g., not started, in progress, completed).
The dashboard should allow filtering tasks by coder, contract, priority, and deadline.
The dashboard should provide quick access to task details and logs.

User Stories.Title: Time Tracking Integration with Invoicing System
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the time tracking data to be integrated with the invoicing system so that I can generate accurate invoices based on the time spent on tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should automatically transfer time tracking data to the invoicing module.
The invoicing module should use the time data to calculate billable hours for each contract.
Invoices should reflect the accurate time spent and be ready for client review.

User Stories.Title: Task Assignment History
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view the history of task assignments and updates so that I can track changes and ensure accountability.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should maintain a log of all task assignments and updates.
The log should include details such as the date of assignment, coder assigned, and any changes made.
The history should be accessible from the task details view.

User Stories.Title: User Role Management for Task Access
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to manage user roles and permissions for task access so that only authorized personnel can view and update tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow setting different roles (e.g., admin, manager, coder) with specific permissions.
Only authorized users should be able to assign, update, or complete tasks.
The system should provide an interface to manage user roles and permissions.

User Stories.Title: Daily Task Summary Email
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to receive a daily email summary of task statuses and time logs so that I can stay informed about project progress without logging into the system.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should generate a daily summary email with task statuses and time logs.
The email should be sent at a configurable time each day.
The content should include key metrics such as tasks completed, tasks in progress, and total time spent.

Project Managers.Title: Project Management and Code Analysis
Project Managers.Description: Develop the Myte Code Checker tool to analyze code changes daily, generate natural language reports, and automatically send updates to contract contacts. This ensures that PMs can keep clients informed about project progress.

User Stories.Title: Daily Code Repository Sync
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to sync with the code repository daily so that I can ensure the latest code changes are analyzed.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should automatically sync with the code repository at a specified time each day.
The sync process should be logged with timestamps for tracking purposes.
Any sync failures should trigger an alert to the Project Manager.

User Stories.Title: Code Change Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to analyze the code changes from the previous day so that I can understand what modifications have been made.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should compare the current codebase with the previous day's codebase.
The analysis should identify all changes, including additions, deletions, and modifications.
The analysis should be completed within a reasonable timeframe (e.g., within 1 hour).

User Stories.Title: Natural Language Report Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to generate a natural language report of the code changes so that I can easily understand and communicate the updates.
AcceptanceCriteria: The report should summarize the changes in clear, concise natural language.
The report should include details such as the files affected, the nature of the changes, and any potential impacts.
The report should be generated automatically after the code analysis is complete.

User Stories.Title: Automated Report Delivery
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to automatically send the generated report to the contract contacts so that clients are kept informed about project progress.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should send the report to the designated contract contacts via email.
The email should be sent at a specified time each day.
The email should include the report as an attachment and a brief summary in the email body.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling and Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the Myte Code Checker to handle errors gracefully and notify me of any issues so that I can address them promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should log any errors encountered during the sync, analysis, or report generation processes.
The system should send an alert to the Project Manager in case of any critical errors.
The alert should include details of the error and suggested actions to resolve it.

User Stories.Title: Customizable Analysis Parameters
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to configure the parameters for code analysis so that the reports meet specific project requirements.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should allow the Project Manager to set parameters such as the time of the daily sync, the scope of the analysis, and the format of the report.
The system should save these configurations for future analyses.
The system should provide an interface for updating these parameters as needed.

User Stories.Title: Historical Report Access
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to access historical reports so that I can review past code changes and track project progress over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should store all generated reports in a searchable database.
The Project Manager should be able to access and download past reports through the user interface.
The system should provide filtering options to easily locate specific reports based on date, project, or other criteria.

User Stories.Title: User-Friendly Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want a user-friendly dashboard to view the status of the daily code analysis and report generation so that I can monitor the process at a glance.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard should display the status of the latest sync, analysis, and report generation processes.
The dashboard should highlight any errors or issues that need attention.
The dashboard should provide quick access to the latest report and historical reports.

Project Managers.Title: Invoicing System
Project Managers.Description: Create a system to prepare invoices based on account/contact information and hours spent by activity. This includes linking the invoicing system to the accounting system to streamline financial processes.

User Stories.Title: Generate Invoice from Account Information
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to generate an invoice using account and contact information so that I can bill clients accurately based on their details.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an account and contact information, when I generate an invoice, then the invoice should include the client's name, address, and contact details.
The invoice should be formatted according to the company's standards.

User Stories.Title: Track Hours Spent by Activity
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to track hours spent by activity so that I can accurately bill clients for the time spent on their projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of activities, when I log hours spent on each activity, then the system should record the time accurately.
The system should allow me to edit logged hours before finalizing the invoice.

User Stories.Title: Prepare Invoice Based on Logged Hours
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to prepare an invoice based on the hours logged by activity so that clients are billed correctly for the work done.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given logged hours for various activities, when I prepare an invoice, then the invoice should reflect the total hours and corresponding charges.
The invoice should break down the hours and charges by activity.

User Stories.Title: Link Invoicing System to Accounting System
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the invoicing system to be linked to the accounting system so that financial processes are streamlined and data consistency is maintained.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an invoice is generated, when it is finalized, then the invoice details should be automatically sent to the accounting system.
The accounting system should update with the new invoice data without manual intervention.

User Stories.Title: Review and Approve Invoices
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to review and approve invoices before they are sent to clients so that I can ensure accuracy and completeness.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a prepared invoice, when I review it, then I should be able to approve or reject the invoice.
If rejected, the system should allow me to make necessary corrections and resubmit for approval.

User Stories.Title: Send Invoices to Clients
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to send approved invoices to clients via email so that they receive their billing information promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an approved invoice, when I send it, then the client should receive the invoice via email.
The email should include the invoice as an attachment and a customizable message body.

User Stories.Title: Track Invoice Status
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to track the status of invoices so that I can monitor which invoices have been sent, paid, or are overdue.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of invoices, when I view the invoice status, then I should see whether each invoice is sent, paid, or overdue.
The system should provide notifications for overdue invoices.

User Stories.Title: Generate Invoice Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to generate reports on invoicing so that I can analyze billing trends and financial performance.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a range of dates, when I generate an invoice report, then the report should include total invoices, amounts billed, amounts received, and outstanding amounts.
The report should be exportable in PDF and Excel formats.

Project Managers.Title: Employee Database Management
