Project Managers.Description: Develop a digital profile system for all employees, enabling PMs to manage end-to-end tasks efficiently. This includes maintaining relevant information and ensuring easy access to employee data.

User Stories.Title: Create Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to create a digital profile for each employee so that I can maintain relevant information and track their activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I navigate to the 'Create Employee Profile' section, I should be able to enter employee details such as name, contact information, job title, and department.
When I save the profile, it should be stored in the employee database and be accessible for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Update Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to update an existing employee's profile so that I can keep their information current.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I navigate to an employee's profile, I should see an 'Edit' button.
When I click 'Edit', I should be able to modify the employee's details and save the changes.
The updated information should be reflected in the employee database immediately.

User Stories.Title: View Employee Profile
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view an employee's profile so that I can quickly access their information and track their activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I navigate to the 'Employee Profiles' section, I should see a list of all employees.
When I click on an employee's name, I should be taken to their profile page displaying all their details.

User Stories.Title: Search Employee Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to search for an employee's profile by name or department so that I can quickly find the information I need.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I navigate to the 'Employee Profiles' section, I should see a search bar.
When I enter a name or department in the search bar and press 'Search', I should see a list of matching employee profiles.

User Stories.Title: Assign Tasks to Employees
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to assign tasks to employees so that I can manage project activities efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I view an employee's profile, I should see an option to 'Assign Task'.
When I click 'Assign Task', I should be able to enter task details such as task name, description, deadline, and priority.
The task should be saved and linked to the employee's profile.

User Stories.Title: Track Employee Task Progress
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to track the progress of tasks assigned to employees so that I can monitor project status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I view an employee's profile, I should see a list of all tasks assigned to them.
Each task should display its current status (e.g., Not Started, In Progress, Completed) and any relevant notes or updates.

User Stories.Title: Generate Employee Performance Reports
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to generate performance reports for employees so that I can evaluate their contributions and productivity.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I navigate to an employee's profile, I should see an option to 'Generate Report'.
When I click 'Generate Report', the system should compile data on the employee's tasks, completion rates, and any other relevant metrics.
The report should be displayed in a readable format and be available for download as a PDF.

User Stories.Title: Set Employee Availability
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to set the availability status of employees so that I can plan tasks and projects accordingly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I view an employee's profile, I should see an option to 'Set Availability'.
When I click 'Set Availability', I should be able to mark the employee as available, unavailable, or on leave.
The availability status should be saved and displayed on the employee's profile.

User Stories.Title: Notify Employees of Assigned Tasks
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to notify employees when tasks are assigned to them so that they are aware of their responsibilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have assigned a task to an employee, the system should automatically send a notification to the employee via email.
The notification should include task details such as task name, description, deadline, and priority.

User Stories.Title: Archive Employee Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to archive the profiles of former employees so that I can keep the active employee list current.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in as a Project Manager, when I view an employee's profile, I should see an option to 'Archive Profile'.
When I click 'Archive Profile', the employee's profile should be moved to an 'Archived' section and no longer appear in the active employee list.
Archived profiles should still be accessible for reference if needed.

Project Managers.Title: Myte Dashboard Development
Project Managers.Description: Create a comprehensive dashboard for PMs to view CRM data, opportunities, contact conversations, current contracts, leads, active proposals, and more. This includes integrating a chatbot to answer questions about company data.

User Stories.Title: View CRM Data on Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view CRM data on the dashboard so that I can easily access and manage company, office, and contact information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays a list of all companies, offices, and contacts.
Each entry in the list includes relevant details such as Name, Company Name, Address, and Phone Number.
The data is updated in real-time to reflect any changes made in the CRM system.

User Stories.Title: Track Opportunities on Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to track new leads and opportunities on the dashboard so that I can monitor their status until they become proposals.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes a section for tracking new leads and opportunities.
Each opportunity displays its current status and associated account.
The status of opportunities is updated in real-time.

User Stories.Title: View Contact Conversations on Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view contact conversations on the dashboard so that I can keep track of all communications with external entities.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard displays a history of all received and sent emails for each contact.
Each email entry includes the Date Received/Sent and the Content of the Email.
The conversation history is updated in real-time to include new emails.

User Stories.Title: Monitor Current Contracts on Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to monitor current contracts on the dashboard so that I can keep track of their progress and associated communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes a section for current contracts.
Each contract entry displays relevant details such as contract status, associated account, and responsible employee.
The contract section is updated in real-time to reflect any changes.

User Stories.Title: View Leads and Active Proposals on Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to view leads and active proposals on the dashboard so that I can manage the proposal process efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes sections for leads and active proposals.
Each lead and proposal entry displays relevant details such as status, associated account, and estimated time and cost.
The leads and proposals sections are updated in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Integrate Chatbot for Company Data Queries
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to use a chatbot integrated into the dashboard to answer questions about company data so that I can quickly access information without manual searches.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard includes a chatbot interface.
The chatbot can answer questions about CRM data, opportunities, contact conversations, contracts, leads, and proposals.
The chatbot uses OpenAI API and is trained on the company's data to provide accurate responses.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Updates on Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the dashboard to provide real-time updates so that I can make informed decisions based on the latest data.
AcceptanceCriteria: All sections of the dashboard (CRM data, opportunities, contact conversations, contracts, leads, proposals) are updated in real-time.
Any changes made in the system are reflected on the dashboard immediately.
The dashboard provides visual indicators for new updates.

User Stories.Title: Customizable Dashboard Views
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want to customize the dashboard views so that I can prioritize the information that is most relevant to my role.
AcceptanceCriteria: The dashboard allows customization of sections to be displayed.
Users can rearrange sections and set filters for the data displayed.
Customizations are saved and persist across sessions.

Project Managers.Title: Client Portal Development
Project Managers.Description: Develop a client portal where clients can view their contracts, communications, and project progress. This includes integrating a chatbot for quick answers and enabling clients to initiate new proposals using Myte Estimates.

User Stories.Title: View Contracts
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want clients to be able to view their contracts in the client portal so that they can easily access and review their agreements with us.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can log into the portal and see a list of their active and historical contracts.
Each contract entry displays key details such as contract ID, start date, end date, and status.
Clients can click on a contract to view the full document and any associated amendments.

User Stories.Title: View Communications
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want clients to be able to view their communications with us in the client portal so that they can track all interactions and correspondence.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can log into the portal and see a list of all communications related to their contracts.
Each communication entry displays the date, sender/receiver, and a brief summary of the content.
Clients can click on a communication entry to view the full email or message content.

User Stories.Title: View Project Progress
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want clients to be able to view the progress of their projects in the client portal so that they can stay informed about the status and milestones.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can log into the portal and see a progress bar or percentage completion for each of their projects.
Detailed progress reports are available, showing completed tasks, pending tasks, and any blockers.
Clients receive automated updates on project progress at regular intervals.

User Stories.Title: Chatbot Integration
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want a chatbot integrated into the client portal so that clients can get quick answers to their questions about their projects.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can access the chatbot from any page within the client portal.
The chatbot can answer common questions about contracts, communications, and project progress.
The chatbot is trained on client-specific data, including emails and progress reports.

User Stories.Title: Initiate New Proposals
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want clients to be able to initiate new proposals using Myte Estimates in the client portal so that they can easily request new projects or changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can log into the portal and access a form to input their requirements for a new proposal.
The system uses Myte Estimates to generate a detailed proposal including requirements, epics, stories, tasks, estimated time, and cost.
Clients can review and submit the proposal for evaluation, which then becomes a lead in our system.

User Stories.Title: Secure Login and Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want secure login and access control for the client portal so that only authorized clients can view their sensitive information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients must log in using a secure authentication process, including multi-factor authentication (MFA).
Access to contract, communication, and project data is restricted to the relevant client only.
All data transmissions are encrypted to ensure data privacy and security.

User Stories.Title: User-Friendly Interface
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want the client portal to have a user-friendly interface so that clients can easily navigate and use the portal without extensive training.
AcceptanceCriteria: The portal has a clean and intuitive design, with clear navigation menus and labels.
Clients can easily find and access their contracts, communications, and project progress.
Help and support resources are available within the portal to assist clients with any issues.

User Stories.Title: Notification System
User Stories.Description: As a Project Manager, I want a notification system in the client portal so that clients are alerted to important updates and changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients receive notifications for new communications, contract updates, and project progress changes.
Notifications can be configured to be sent via email or displayed within the portal.
Clients can manage their notification preferences in the portal settings.

AI System Developers.Title: Email Extraction and Analysis System
AI System Developers.Description: Develop a system to extract emails from Gmail and analyze them using OpenAI GPT-4o. This includes extracting details like Name, Company Name, Address, and Phone Number, and maintaining a conversation history for each contact.

User Stories.Title: Extract Received Emails from Gmail
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to extract all received emails from Gmail so that I can analyze them for contact details.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system connects to the Gmail API and retrieves all received emails.
Emails are stored in a local database for further processing.
The system handles API rate limits and errors gracefully.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Email Content with OpenAI GPT-4o
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to use OpenAI GPT-4o to analyze the content of received emails so that I can extract details like Name, Company Name, Address, and Phone Number.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system sends email content to OpenAI GPT-4o for analysis.
Extracted details (Name, Company Name, Address, Phone Number) are stored in the local database.
The system logs any errors or issues encountered during the analysis.

User Stories.Title: Maintain Conversation History for Contacts
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to maintain a conversation history for each contact so that I can track all interactions over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system creates a conversation history for each contact, including all received emails with Date Received and Content.
Conversation history is updated in real-time as new emails are received.
The system ensures data consistency and integrity when updating conversation histories.

User Stories.Title: Extract Sent Emails from Gmail
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to extract all sent emails from Gmail so that I can associate them with the corresponding contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system connects to the Gmail API and retrieves all sent emails.
Sent emails are stored in a local database for further processing.
The system handles API rate limits and errors gracefully.

User Stories.Title: Associate Sent Emails with Contacts
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to associate sent emails with the corresponding contacts so that I can maintain a complete conversation history.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system matches sent emails to existing contacts based on email addresses.
Sent emails are added to the conversation history with Date Sent and Content.
The system ensures data consistency and integrity when updating conversation histories.

User Stories.Title: Implement Continuous Syncing Process
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to implement a continuous syncing process so that contact information is always up-to-date with all received and sent emails.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system periodically checks for new received and sent emails.
New emails are processed and added to the local database in real-time.
The system ensures no duplicate entries and maintains data consistency.

User Stories.Title: Handle API Rate Limits and Errors
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to handle API rate limits and errors gracefully so that the system remains robust and reliable.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system implements retry logic for API calls that fail due to rate limits or temporary errors.
Errors are logged with sufficient detail for troubleshooting.
The system provides alerts or notifications for persistent issues that require manual intervention.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Storage and Access
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to ensure secure data storage and access so that sensitive information is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.
Access to the database is restricted to authorized users only.
The system complies with relevant data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

AI System Developers.Title: AI-Powered CRM Initialization
AI System Developers.Description: Implement AI models to initialize the CRM by analyzing historical emails to populate contact details and conversation history. Ensure continuous syncing to keep contact information up-to-date.

User Stories.Title: Extract Historical Emails
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to extract all historical emails from Gmail so that I can analyze them to populate the CRM with contact details and conversation history.
AcceptanceCriteria: All received emails are extracted from the Gmail account.
All sent emails are extracted from the Gmail account.
Emails are stored in a structured format suitable for analysis.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Email Content
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to use OpenAI GPT-4o to analyze the content of extracted emails so that I can extract contact details such as Name, Company Name, Address, and Phone Number.
AcceptanceCriteria: Emails are processed using OpenAI GPT-4o.
Contact details (Name, Company Name, Address, Phone Number) are accurately extracted from the email content.
Extracted details are stored in the CRM.

User Stories.Title: Maintain Conversation History
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to maintain a conversation history for each contact so that all email interactions are stored and easily accessible.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each contact has a conversation history field in the CRM.
Conversation history includes all received emails with Date Received and Content.
Conversation history includes all sent emails with Date Sent and Content.

User Stories.Title: Continuous Email Syncing
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to implement a continuous syncing process so that contact information in the CRM is always up-to-date with the latest received and sent emails.
AcceptanceCriteria: Newly received emails are automatically extracted and analyzed.
Newly sent emails are automatically extracted and analyzed.
CRM contact details and conversation history are updated in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling for Email Extraction
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to implement error handling for the email extraction process so that any issues are logged and addressed without disrupting the system.
AcceptanceCriteria: Errors during email extraction are logged with detailed information.
The system retries extraction in case of temporary failures.
Alerts are generated for persistent issues requiring manual intervention.

User Stories.Title: Data Security and Privacy
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to ensure data security and privacy during email extraction and analysis so that sensitive information is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Emails are transmitted and stored using encryption.
Access to email data is restricted to authorized personnel.
Compliance with data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) is ensured.

User Stories.Title: Scalability of Email Analysis
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to design the email analysis process to be scalable so that it can handle increasing volumes of emails as the company grows.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system can process large volumes of emails efficiently.
Performance metrics are monitored to ensure scalability.
The system can be scaled horizontally and vertically as needed.

User Stories.Title: Integration with CRM
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to integrate the email analysis results with the CRM system so that contact details and conversation history are automatically updated.
AcceptanceCriteria: Extracted contact details are correctly mapped to CRM fields.
Conversation history is accurately linked to the corresponding contacts.
CRM updates are performed in real-time without manual intervention.

User Stories.Title: Testing and Validation
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to implement testing and validation processes for email extraction and analysis so that the system performs accurately and reliably.
AcceptanceCriteria: Unit tests are created for email extraction and analysis functions.
Integration tests ensure correct CRM updates.
Performance tests validate system scalability and efficiency.

User Stories.Title: User Documentation
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to create user documentation for the email extraction and analysis system so that other developers and stakeholders understand how to use and maintain it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Comprehensive documentation is created for all system components.
Documentation includes setup instructions, usage guidelines, and troubleshooting tips.
Documentation is reviewed and updated regularly to reflect system changes.

AI System Developers.Title: AI-Driven Proposal Generation
AI System Developers.Description: Integrate Myte Estimates tool to use AI for generating detailed project breakdowns and proposals. This includes estimating time, cost, and identifying risks based on client requirements.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Client Requirements
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want to analyze client requirements using AI so that I can generate detailed project breakdowns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a set of client requirements, when the requirements are input into the system, then the AI should analyze and categorize them into epics, stories, and tasks.
The AI should be able to identify and extract key details such as project scope, objectives, and deliverables.

User Stories.Title: Estimate Time and Cost
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want the AI to estimate time and cost for each task so that I can provide accurate project proposals.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a list of tasks, when the AI processes these tasks, then it should output estimated time and cost for each task.
The estimates should be based on historical data and predefined metrics.

User Stories.Title: Identify Project Risks
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want the AI to identify potential risks in the project so that I can include risk mitigation strategies in the proposal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a set of project requirements, when the AI analyzes these requirements, then it should identify potential risks and categorize them by severity.
The AI should suggest possible mitigation strategies for each identified risk.

User Stories.Title: Generate PDF Proposal
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want the AI to generate a PDF proposal so that I can send a professional document to the client.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the analyzed requirements, estimated time and cost, and identified risks, when the AI processes this information, then it should generate a PDF document.
The PDF should include sections for project breakdown, estimated time and cost, and identified risks with mitigation strategies.

User Stories.Title: Send Proposal to Client
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want the system to send the generated proposal to the client's email so that the client can review it.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated PDF proposal, when the user selects the option to send, then the system should email the PDF to the client's email address.
The email should include a subject line and body text that can be customized before sending.

User Stories.Title: Store Proposal in Database
User Stories.Description: As an AI System Developer, I want the system to store the generated proposals in a database so that I can track and manage them.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a generated PDF proposal, when the proposal is created, then it should be stored in a database with a unique identifier.
